# ConfigHost

Package `FNS_ConfigHost`.

A standalone ConfigRegistry host. Drop it into a component to give it roaming settings; its parameters save and reload with your config, with per-parameter and per-page exclusions.

- Category: Developer
- Version: 3.2.8
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-confighost/

## What it does

- **Roaming settings for any component**: Drop it inside a component and that component's custom parameters are written into the shared settings file and restored on load.
- **Parameter and page exclusions**: Name patterns, or whole parameter pages, stay out of what is saved, for parameters that must boot at their defaults.
- **Registry page on the parent**: The host's key settings are mirrored onto the component as a Registry page, so it can be configured without opening the host.
- **Edit on the settings page**: With the toolkit installed, the component is listed on the FNS settings page beside every FNS tool, its parameters editable there.
- **Named settings section**: The canonical name is the section the settings are stored under, defaulting to the component's name; renaming it orphans values saved under the old name.
- **Global or per project**: Follows the toolkit's choice between one settings file shared by every project and settings kept in the .toe.
- **Save and load callbacks**: onConfigSave and onConfigLoad save and restore anything JSON-serializable, such as table rows; a pulse writes the starter DAT.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_CONFIGREGISTRY` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: True when at least one dropped item could become a host here.
- `CloseSettingsUI()`: Close the console, the settings UI, when it is up.
- `ConfigData` (property): Parsed, schema-gated, mtime-cached view of the file.
- `ConfigPath` (property): Absolute path of the aggregated config file.
- `ConfigScopeChanged(par, prev)`: Confirm the risky flip.
- `CreateCallbacks()`: Spawn a `config_callbacks` DAT into this host's tool and point the host's Callback parameter at it.
- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `LoadAll()`: Explicitly re-apply every registered tool's saved section.
- `LoadAllConfigs()`: Load every registered tool's config.
- `LoadTool(canonical_name, force=False)`: Apply a tool's saved section onto the live tool now.
- `OpenConfigSettings()`: Open the FNS_Config settings UI.
- `OpenSettingsUI(tab=None, panel=True)`: Open the FNS console on its Settings tab (or `tab`).
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `RegisterTool(comp, canonical_name, callback=None, autoload=True, persist_pars=True, exclude_pars='', exclude_pages='', source_registry=None)`: Publish a tool COMP for settings persistence under canonical_name.
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `SaveAll()`: Snapshot every registered tool into the aggregated file (the ONLY code path that writes it).
- `SaveAllConfigs()`: Save every registered tool's config.
- `SaveTool(canonical_name)`: Read-merge-write a single tool's section.
- `ScopeAudit()`: [(path, problem)] for every copy of this registry that does not carry the guarded Configscope: 'missing', 'bind' or 'unguarded'.
- `SetConfigScope(value, prompt=False)`: Flip the config scope programmatically ('global' / 'project').
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `StampHost(target_comp, canonical_name=None, autoregister=True, promote_pars=True, par_values=None)`: Copy THIS master into `target_comp` as a configured host.
- `ToggleGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: flip a group; returns the new state.
- `Tools` (property): Manager API: snapshot of all registered tool entries.
- `UiExport(save=True)`: A portable config document snapshotted from the LIVE tools.
- `UiImport(data)`: Apply an exported/roamed config document from the page.
- `UiScope(value=None, mode=None)`: Read or flip the config scope from the console.
- `UiSet(canonical_name, par_name, value)`: Set ONE par from the page and persist it through SaveTool.
- `UiState()`: Everything the settings page needs, in one call.
- `UnregisterPanel(canonical_name)`: RegistryBase's teardown name for UnregisterTool.
- `UnregisterTool(canonical_name)`: Remove a tool's registration from the settings registry (forwarded to the /sys global).

## Commands

- **Load all tool configs** (id `loadallconfigs`): Load every registered tool's config. Method `LoadAllConfigs`.
- **Open FNS settings** (id `openconfigsettings`): Open the FNS_Config settings UI. Method `OpenConfigSettings`.
- **Save all tool configs** (id `saveallconfigs`): Save every registered tool's config. Method `SaveAllConfigs`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Registration

- **Tool COMP** (`par.Comp`, COMP), default `..`: Tool COMP whose settings are persisted. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique name for this tool's section in the config file.
- **Callback DAT** (`par.Callback`, DAT): Optional config_callbacks DAT for state beyond parameters (onConfigSave/onConfigLoad).
- **Create Callbacks** (`par.Createcallbacks`, Pulse): Spawn a 'config_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.
- **Auto-register** (`par.Autoregister`, Toggle), default `off`: When on, keep this tool published into the global config registry while this component exists.
- **Register** (`par.Register`, Pulse): Publish once into the global config registry, even if Auto-register is off.
- **Unregister** (`par.Unregister`, Pulse): Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.
- **Registration Status** (`par.Regstatus`, Str): Read-only status of this host registration.
- **Auto-load** (`par.Autoload`, Toggle), default `on`: Apply this tool's saved section from the config file once per session, shortly after the tool registers. Turn off for a tool whose settings should stay project-local.
- **Persist Parameters** (`par.Persistpars`, Toggle), default `on`: Snapshot and restore the tool COMP's custom parameters (value, expression, bind + mode). Meta pages (About, Version Ctrl, Info, Callbacks, Common) are always skipped; missing parameters are never created on load.
- **Exclude Pars** (`par.Excludepars`, Str): Space-separated name patterns (tdu.match) of custom parameters to leave out of persistence, e.g. 'Spoutactive Ndi*'. Use for parameters that must boot at their defaults.
- **Exclude Pages** (`par.Excludepages`, Str): Space-separated page-name patterns to leave out of persistence entirely.
- **Help URL** (`par.Helpurl`, Str): The tool's wiki/help page. Informational for config; leave empty to skip.
- **Promote Parameters** (`par.Promotepars`, Toggle), default `on`: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

### Config

- **Config Scope** (`par.Configscope`, Menu), default `global`, menu `global`, `project`: Follows the toolkit root's Config Scope (op.FNS, FNSTools page) through a guarded expression, and reads 'project' when there is no root: a standalone tool release keeps its settings in the .toe. Author on the root; the root par is the record.
- **Config File** (`par.Configfile`, File): Override the config file location. Empty = the user palette default (FNSTools/config/FNStools_config.json). Evaluated by the /sys global; set it on the FNS_Config master so promotion carries it.
- **Save All Now** (`par.Saveall`, Pulse): Snapshot every registered tool into the config file now (forwards to the global).
- **Load All Now** (`par.Loadall`, Pulse): Re-apply every registered tool's saved section now (forwards to the global).

# Console

Package `FNS_Console`.

The toolkit's web front, served from inside your project: every tool's settings on one page, the install picker, and any tab a tool contributes. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.19
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-console/

## What it does

- **Settings for every tool on one page**: Each installed tool appears as a card with its parameters grouped by page, with a jump list and a search across all of them.
- **Open on any tab**: Open Settings, Pick Tools and Open Console open it in Hub, the toolkit root's panel or your system browser, and the tab sits in the address so a reload or a link keeps it.
- **Install and remove**: The installer's picker in a tab: check a tool to install it, uncheck an installed one to remove it, and its settings are kept for next time.
- **Updates in one list**: Compares what you have installed with what the store publishes, shows each update's notes, and applies one update or all of them.
- **Community tools**: Lists tools by other creators, and places some of them straight into the network you are working in.
- **Config scope, global or project**: The Settings header switches your settings between global and project scope.
- **Export settings**: Writes every tool's settings to one JSON file in the config folder and offers it as a download.
- **Import settings**: Applies a settings file to the tools you have now and keeps the sections for tools you install later.
- **Show or hide tabs**: The ⋯ button shows or hides each contributed tab, and the choice is saved on the tool that contributed it.
- **Runs only while in use**: Served on 127.0.0.1 from inside your project; it starts when you open it and stops after ten idle minutes.
- **Contribute a tab**: A stamped FNS_Console host publishes a tool's own HTML page as a console tab, with an optional Python DAT answering its requests.
- **Browser hand-off**: While a tool's tab is exposed, the console switches the tool's own web render off, and back on when the exposure ends.
- **HTTP API**: Routes on the console's port list and show tabs, read and set settings, export and import them, and drive updates from another page.
- **Python API**: `op.FNS_CONSOLE` opens and closes the console, lists and shows tabs, and registers a tab without a host.
- **Hot-synced sources**: Disk edits to the externalized console sources reach the running console on its next request.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_CONSOLE` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: True when at least one dropped item could become a host here.
- `Close()`: Stop serving the console: its web server goes inactive.
- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `Open(tab=None, panel=True)`: Serve the console and show it.
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `RegisterTab(comp, canonical, page=None, api_dat=None, label='', order=50, displayed=True, source_registry=None)`: Publish a tab: `page` (text DAT) is served as-is under /t/<canonical>/; `api_dat` (optional) answers /t/<canonical>/api/* through its onConsoleRequest(action, method, body).
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `Serve(tab=None)`: Make sure the console is being served and return its URL (with the tab fragment when given) -- WITHOUT showing it anywhere.
- `ServeTab(canonical, subpath='', method='GET', body=None)`: Answer one request under /t/<canonical>/: '' -> the page, 'api/<action>' -> the api DAT.
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `SetTabDisplayed(canonical, displayed)`: Show or hide a contributed tab.
- `StampHost(target_comp, canonical_name=None, autoregister=True, promote_pars=True, par_values=None)`: Copy THIS master into `target_comp` as a configured host.
- `Tabs(include_hidden=False)`: Every tab, in order: the built-ins (always displayed), then the live contributions (a registration whose page DAT is gone is skipped, never shown broken).
- `ToggleGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: flip a group; returns the new state.
- `UiBaseCss()`: The shared UI base, served at /base.css for contributed tabs.
- `UiUpdates()`: The Updates tab's whole state in one answer: Compare() rows (no network -- the store manifest already on disk), per-package release notes from that manifest, and whether a check/update pass is live.
- `UiUpdatesApply(names=None)`: Kick UpdateProject() for `names` (or everything that differs when empty).
- `UiUpdatesCheck()`: Kick CheckUpdates() -- manifest only, deliberately cheap.
- `UiUpdatesStatus()`: The live pass, for the page's poll: stage, the updater's own narration, and -- once settled -- the per-package results.
- `UiUpdatesTakeOver(path=None, confirm=False)`: Bring a standalone copy of a global tool under the toolkit (FNS_Updater.TakeOver, docs/StandaloneTakeover.md).
- `UnregisterPanel(canonical)`: Remove a contributed console tab (forwarded to the /sys global).
- `UnregisterTab(canonical)`: Remove a contributed console tab (forwarded to the /sys global).
- `Url()`: The console's URL if it is serving right now, else None.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Registration

- **Tool COMP** (`par.Comp`, COMP), default `..`: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique, URL-safe name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). It is the path: /t/<name>/. Leave empty to use the tool COMP name.
- **Tab Page** (`par.Tabpage`, DAT): Text DAT holding the tab's HTML. Served verbatim in the console under /t/<name>/. Inline its CSS and JS; relative fetches resolve under that path.
- **Tab API** (`par.Tabapi`, DAT): Optional Python DAT defining onConsoleRequest(action, method, body) -> JSON-able. Answers /t/<name>/api/<action>; body is the parsed JSON of a POST, else None.
- **Local Browser** (`par.Localbrowser`, COMP): Optional: the tool's own web browser panel (a palette webBrowser COMP) rendering the same page. While this tab is exposed the console serves the page, so the console switches that browser's Active off, a renderer nobody looks at, and back on when the exposure ends.
- **Expose to Console** (`par.Autoregister`, Toggle), default `on`: Publish this tab into the console while the component exists. Off = the tool runs only its own local interface and contributes nothing.
- **Register** (`par.Register`, Pulse): Publish once into the console, even if Expose is off.
- **Unregister** (`par.Unregister`, Pulse): Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

- **Shown in Console** (`par.Displayed`, Toggle), default `on`: Show this tab on the console's tab bar. Off keeps the tab registered but hidden. It stays listed in the console's tab manager, which writes its choice back here.

- **Pre-Save Heal** (`par.Presaveheal`, Toggle), default `on`: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

### Console

- **Open Console** (`par.Open`, Pulse): Serve the console (on the first free port of 36710-36759) and show it, in the toolkit root's webBrowser panel when there is one, else your system browser.

# CustomParTools

Package `FNS_CustomParTools`.

Promote parameters to a parent with binds or expressions, customize name/label/range on drop, plus extension creation, parent shortcuts, parameter clearing and IOP promotion. Also carries the pane-bar drag-drop hijack and path-cell injection, and four stock-TouchDesigner shortcuts for opening parameters and the COMP editor.

- Category: Parameters
- Version: 3.2.15
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-custompartools/

## What it does

- **Promote by drop**: Drop a parameter on the button or on a parent in the path bar and it becomes a custom parameter there, bound back to the original.
- **Customise as you promote**: Hold `Ctrl` while dropping to set the name, label, range, clamping and default before the parameter is created.
- **Menu parameter from a table**: Drop a Table DAT and the parent gets a menu parameter that takes its entries from the table.
- **Promote the hovered parameter**: `Alt+X` promotes the parameter under the mouse and `Alt+\` opens it in the Component Editor, with nothing to select or drag.
- **Clear dangling binds and expressions**: Switches parameters with a dangling bind or a failing expression back to constant and clears script errors, on the selected COMP and its immediate children.
- **Add a parent shortcut**: Gives a COMP a parent shortcut from the button or quick-launch, starting from its name or the shortcut it already has.
- **Internal OPs by drop**: A `Ctrl+Alt` drop adds an operator to the parent, or to a parent in the path bar, as an iop.
- **Open parameters and the Component Editor**: Open the parameter dialog or the Component Editor for the selected operator or the current network's COMP from the button, the keyboard or quick-launch.
- **Create an extension in one click**: QuickExt gives a COMP a Python extension with the starting code written, ExtUtils docked and the extension slot filled in.
- **Switch parts off**: Each part switches off on its own, and its button or pane-bar widget goes away with it.
- **Parameters as extension properties**: CustomParHelper gives an extension `self.evalSpeed` and `self.parSpeed` for every custom parameter.
- **Callbacks by parameter name**: A method named `onParSpeed` runs when the Speed parameter changes, with matching names for pulses, parameter groups and sequences.
- **Declare parameters in code**: Helpers such as `CustomParHelper.Float` and `CustomParHelper.Menu` create custom parameters from `__init__`, with page, range and help text.
- **Name your own handlers**: `@CustomParHelper.onPar('Speed')` binds any method to a parameter, and a mistyped parameter name is reported in the log.
- **Execute callbacks without nodes**: NoNode registers CHOP, DAT and parameter execute callbacks from extension code or from decorators on the methods, with no execute DATs in the network.
- **Keyboard shortcuts from code**: `NoNode.RegisterKeyboardShortcut` binds a key such as `ctrl.k` to an extension method, and `DeregisterKeyboardShortcut` removes it.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_CPP` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `CustomizeCurrentComp()`: Open the component editor on the selected operator.
- `CustomizeParentComp()`: Open the component editor on the current network's COMP.
- `DoPromoteAll(exceptions=None)`: Promote every parameter of the reference operator's current page onto the target.
- `IsParGroup(par)`: Whether a parameter belongs to a multi-component group, so the whole group is promoted.
- `ModuleEnabled(module)`: True when `module` is switched on, on the Modules page.
- `OnCustomizeCallback(info)`: Called when the customize dialog closes; promotes the parameter with the entered name, label and range when OK was pressed.
- `OnCustomizeParameterDropped(dropParam)`: Open the customize dialog for a parameter or group dropped on the tool; called by the drop handler.
- `OnEditText(field, text)`: Called by the customize dialog on text entry; remembers the typed parameter name.
- `OpenCurrentParameters()`: Open a floating parameter dialog for the selected operator.
- `OpenParentParameters()`: Open a floating parameter dialog for the current network's COMP.
- `PromotePar(_par, page_name, target=None, refBind=None, parName=None, parLabel=None, parMin=None, parMax=None, clamp=None, parDefault=None)`: Promote one parameter onto the target as a custom parameter bound, or referenced, back to the original.
- `PromoteParGroup(_parGroup, page_name, target=None, refBind=None, parName=None, parLabel=None)`: Promote one parameter group (a vector or a color) onto the target as a custom parameter group bound back to the reference.
- `PromoteSelected()`: Promote custom parameters of the selected operators.
- `Reference` (property): The operator whose parameters are promoted (settable by OP or path).
- `SetTableMenu(_table, _target)`: Create a menu custom parameter on the target from a table DAT's rows (name and label columns).
- `Target` (property): The COMP the promoted parameters are created on (settable by COMP or path; a non-COMP clears it).

## Commands

- **Customize current COMP** (id `customizecurrentcomp`): Open the component editor on the selected operator. Method `CustomizeCurrentComp`.
- **Customize parent COMP** (id `customizeparentcomp`): Open the component editor on the current network's COMP. Method `CustomizeParentComp`.
- **Open current COMP parameters** (id `opencurrentparameters`): Open a floating parameter dialog for the selected operator. Method `OpenCurrentParameters`.
- **Open parent COMP parameters** (id `openparentparameters`): Open a floating parameter dialog for the current network's COMP. Method `OpenParentParameters`.
- **Promote pars of selected** (id `promoteselected`): Promote custom parameters of the selected operators. Method `PromoteSelected`.
- **Clear custom pars of selected** (id `clearselectedpars`): Remove ALL custom parameters from the selected operators (undoable). Method `ClearSelectedPars` on `ClearPars`.
- **Create extension on current** (id `createextoncurrent`): Run QuickExt's extension creator on the current COMP. Method `CreateExtOnCurrent` on `QuickExt`.
- **Toggle QuickParCustom** (id `toggleactive`): Enable or disable QuickParCustom. Method `ToggleActive` on `QuickParCustom`.
- **Add parent shortcut** (id `addshortcuttocurrent`): Add a parent shortcut to the current COMP (prompts for the name). Method `AddShortcutToCurrent` on `QuickParent`.

## Hotkeys

- `alt.\` (`Shortcutrollovercustomize` on `QuickParCustom`)
- `alt.x` (`Shortcutrolloverpromote` on `QuickParCustom`)
- `ctrl.alt.\` (`Shortcutrolloverswitchparmode` on `QuickParCustom`)
- `ctrl.alt.q` (`Shortcutparentpars` on `FNS_CustomParTools`)
- `ctrl.alt.w` (`Shortcutparentcomp` on `FNS_CustomParTools`)
- `shift.alt.q` (`Shortcutcurrentpars` on `FNS_CustomParTools`)
- `shift.alt.w` (`Shortcutcurrentcomp` on `FNS_CustomParTools`)
- `shift.alt.x` (`Shortcutrolloverpromotemod` on `QuickParCustom`)

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_NavbarRegistry`
- `FNS_ToolbarRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Ref/Bind** (`par.Refbind`, Toggle), default `off`: How a promoted parameter is linked back to the original. On binds the two (either end can be edited and both follow); off leaves the original in expression mode pointing at the promoted one. Holding the modifier while promoting inverts this for that one action.
- **Promote All** (`par.Promote`, Pulse): Promote every custom parameter on the current page of the referenced COMP to the target COMP at once, linked according to Ref/Bind.
- **Params: Selected** (`par.Shortcutcurrentpars`, Str), default `shift.alt.q`: Hotkey that opens the parameter dialog for the SELECTED operator. Rebindable here or in FNS_HotkeyManager.
- **Params: Current COMP** (`par.Shortcutparentpars`, Str), default `ctrl.alt.q`: Hotkey that opens the parameter dialog for the COMP whose network is showing.
- **Editor: Selected** (`par.Shortcutcurrentcomp`, Str), default `shift.alt.w`: Hotkey that opens the component editor for the SELECTED operator.
- **Editor: Current COMP** (`par.Shortcutparentcomp`, Str), default `ctrl.alt.w`: Hotkey that opens the component editor for the COMP whose network is showing.

### Modules

- **Parameter Promotion** (`par.Activeparpromote`, Toggle), default `on`: Drop a parameter onto the CustomParTools button to promote it onto the current network COMP. The core action of the tool.
- **QuickExt** (`par.Activequickext`, Toggle), default `on`: Create an extension on the current COMP from the button.
- **QuickParent** (`par.Activequickparent`, Toggle), default `on`: Set a parent shortcut on the current COMP from the button.
- **ClearPars** (`par.Activeclearpars`, Toggle), default `on`: Alt-click (Cmd on macOS) the button to clear the custom parameters of the current child.
- **IOP Promoter** (`par.Activeioppromoter`, Toggle), default `on`: Hold the modifier while dropping an operator on the button to promote it as an Internal OP instead of promoting parameters.
- **Navbar Drag/Drop** (`par.Activehijackdragdrop`, Toggle), default `on`: Accept operator and parameter drops anywhere on the pane navigation bar. Off UNREGISTERS the widget, removing it from every bar.
- **Navbar Path Cell Click** (`par.Activepathcellclickinject`, Toggle), default `on`: Open parameters for the operator whose path cell you click in the pane bar. Off UNREGISTERS the widget, removing it from every bar.
- **QuickParCustom** (`par.Activequickparcustom`, Toggle), default `on`: Rollover hotkeys for promoting and customizing the parameter under the mouse. Bound to QuickParCustom's own Active switch.
- **Parameter/Editor Hotkeys** (`par.Activetdshortcuts`, Toggle), default `on`: The four stock-TouchDesigner hotkeys on the Custom page (open parameters, open component editor). Off deactivates the keyboardins; the matching quick-launch commands stay available.

# ExprHotStrings

Package `FNS_ExprHotStrings`.

Abbreviations that expand into TouchDesigner expressions as you type in a parameter field.

- Category: Parameters
- Version: 3.2.9
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-exprhotstrings/

## What it does

- **Abbreviation table**: A table of abbreviations and what they expand to, so `#AT` typed as an expression becomes `absTime.seconds`.
- **Inline expansion**: With Replace inline on, abbreviations also expand in the middle of an expression and can be combined, as in `#AT * 0.2`.
- **Externalize the table to a file**: With Externalize on, the table is kept in a file, so your abbreviations follow you from project to project.
- **Wrap a name in op()**: `#@noise1.par.amp` becomes `op('noise1').par.amp`.
- **Parent shortcut abbreviations**: `#!` becomes the closest parent shortcut, and `#!!` the same with `.par` after it.
- **Promote a parameter while typing**: `#@!` and `#@~` turn the parameter you are typing in into a custom parameter on its parent, linked by a bind or an expression.

## Reach it

`op.HOTSTRINGS` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `HotstringCheck(OP, PAR, EXPR, BINDEXPR, _depth=0)`: Expand a hotstring abbreviation found in a parameter's expression, or bind expression, into its full text; called when an expression changes.
- `OpenHotStrings()`: Open the expression hot-strings editor.

## Commands

- **Open hot-strings editor** (id `openhotstrings`): Open the expression hot-strings editor. Method `OpenHotStrings`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_HubRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Replace inline** (`par.Replaceinline`, Toggle), default `off`: Expand an abbreviation anywhere inside an expression, not only when it is the whole expression. Off by default: with it on you can write '#AT * 0.2' and combine abbreviations.
- **CustomPar Promote Enable (#@! for binds, #!~ for refs)** (`par.Customparpromoteenable`, Toggle), default `on`: Enable the promote abbreviations: '#@!' binds a parameter to the parent and '#!~' references it. On by default.
- **Externalize** (`par.Sync`, Toggle), default `off`: Externalize the abbreviation table to a file on disk, so it can be edited outside TouchDesigner and version-controlled.
- **#@op Wrap Enable** (`par.Openable`, Toggle), default `off`: Enable the '#@' abbreviation, which wraps whatever follows in op('...'). '#@noise1.par.amp' becomes op('noise1').par.amp.
- **#! Parent Shortcut Enable** (`par.Parentshortcutenable`, Toggle), default `off`: Enable the '#!' abbreviations, which resolve to the closest parent shortcut ('#!' alone, or '#!!' with .par appended).
- **Edit Table** (`par.Open`, Pulse): Open the abbreviation table, where the first column is what you type and the second is what it expands to.
- **Author: Function Store @function.str** (`par.Author`, Header)
- **Usage:** (`par.Usage`, Header)
- **- add new lines to the table** (`par.L1`, Header)
- **- start abbreviation (first column) with a unique character** (`par.L2`, Header)
- **- it will expand to what you write in the second column** (`par.L3`, Header)
- **- type the abbreviation into a parameter's expression box** (`par.L4`, Header)
- **- and keep your mouse over it to expand!** (`par.L5`, Header)
- **- The contents of the table are saved across your projects if sync is enabled!** (`par.L6`, Header)
- **- If enabled #@ will wrap strings after it in op('...') in a smart way** (`par.L7`, Header)
- **- If enabled #! will resolve to the closest parent shortcut** (`par.L9`, Header)
- **-- and #!! will also add a .par after it** (`par.L10`, Header)
- **- If enabled #@! or #!~ will promote parameter as custom par** (`par.L11`, Header)
- **-- Can also directly write a custom name such as #@!Myfloat** (`par.L12`, Header)
- **- The definitions can be synced across projects if Externalized is enabled** (`par.L8`, Header)

# HotkeyManager

Package `FNS_HotkeyManager`.

Unified hotkey discovery, conflict detection and rebinding UI across the whole toolkit.

- Category: Interface
- Version: 3.2.10
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-hotkeymanager/

## What it does

- **Find every hotkey in the project**: Scans the whole project, toolkit tools and your own components alike, for Keyboard In CHOPs and DATs and shortcut parameters, one row per binding.
- **Rebind by pressing keys**: Click a Hotkey cell and press the new keys; a combo already in use asks you to press it again to take it.
- **Reset a binding**: Right-click a Hotkey cell to put that binding back to its default.
- **Conflict detection**: Combos bound by more than one tool are flagged CONFLICT, and clicking the flag jumps between the rows that share it.
- **Copies listed once**: A component copied around the project is one row, and rebinding it rewrites every copy.
- **Persist bindings across projects**: Toolkit hotkeys follow you to other projects and through updates, and any other binding can opt in with a tag or a click.
- **Save, load and defaults**: Save, reload or put back the default bindings, or force the defaults on every load to get a machine back to a known state.
- **Discovery rules for tool authors**: Where to put a binding so it is found and gets a default that survives renames and moves.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_HOTKEY_MANAGER` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `AllHotkeyPars()`: (operator, parameter_name) tuples for the parexec watcher.
- `ApplyBinding(display_path: str, par_name: str, combo: str)`: Write a new combo onto a binding.
- `BeginCapture(display_path: str, par_name: str)`: Arm the capture keyboardin; next non-modifier keypress becomes the binding.
- `CancelCapture()`: Abandon a key capture in progress and refresh the UI.
- `ComputeConflicts()`: combo -> [records] for every combo bound by more than one tool.
- `ConfigLoadRows(data)`: Merge config rows into the gathered table -- update by path+par, insert unknown, remember unresolvable rows as orphans, leave every project-local row untouched -- then apply through the standard load path (watch suppressed).
- `ConfigSaveRows()`: Declared rows of the gathered table, for config_callbacks onConfigSave.
- `Discover()`: Scan every top-level COMP (minus excluded roots) for hotkey-bearing parameters.
- `JumpToConflictPartner(display_path: str, par_name: str)`: Select and scroll to the partner row of this row's conflicted combo; repeated clicks cycle through partners when there are several.
- `LoadHotkeysCmd()`: Load the saved hotkey bindings.
- `OnCaptureKey(key, character, alt, ctrl, shift, state, cmd=False)`: Called by the capture keyboardin's onKey callback.
- `OpenHotkeyUI()`: Open the hotkey manager lister.
- `OpenUI()`: Open the hotkey manager window, refreshing the bindings and the conflict list first.
- `RefreshAll()`: Full re-scan + UI rebuild (UI Refresh button).
- `RefreshUI()`: Rebuild the UI table the lister displays.
- `ResetToDefault(display_path: str, par_name: str)`: Restore one binding to its default.
- `SaveHotkeys()`: Externalize the current live bindings into the gathered table.
- `SaveHotkeysCmd()`: Save the current hotkey bindings.
- `ShowConflictPartners(display_path: str, par_name: str)`: Surface who else binds this row's conflicted combo in the hint bar.
- `TogglePersist(display_path: str, par_name: str)`: Persist-column click: flip the CONFIG_TAG on the row's source op.

## Commands

- **Load hotkeys** (id `loadhotkeyscmd`): Load the saved hotkey bindings. Method `LoadHotkeysCmd`.
- **Open hotkey UI** (id `openhotkeyui`): Open the hotkey manager lister. Method `OpenHotkeyUI`.
- **Save hotkeys** (id `savehotkeyscmd`): Save the current hotkey bindings. Method `SaveHotkeysCmd`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_HubRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Active** (`par.Active`, Toggle), default `on`: Turn hotkey management on or off. Off leaves every binding as it is but stops the manager applying, saving or restoring them.
- **Save Hotkeys** (`par.Savehotkeys`, Pulse): Write the declared bindings to your user palette now, so they survive project files and updates. Toolkit hotkeys are always declared; anything else has to be tagged FNS_hotkeys or ticked in the lister's Persist column.
- **Load Hotkeys** (`par.Loadhotkeys`, Pulse): Re-apply the saved bindings from your user palette over what is bound right now.
- **Load Default** (`par.Loaddefault`, Pulse): Put every discovered binding back to the default its own parameter declares, discarding your saved bindings for this session.
- **Force Default** (`par.Forcedefault`, Toggle), default `off`: Ignore saved bindings entirely and use each parameter's declared default on every load. Use it to get a machine back to a known state; leave it off to keep your own bindings.
- **Excluded Roots** (`par.Excluderoots`, Str), default `ui sys local`: Space-separated names of top-level components to SKIP during project-wide hotkey discovery. TD's own ui/sys/local are excluded by default; add other roots here to silence them.
- **Open Hotkey UI** (`par.Openui`, Pulse): Open the hotkey configurator panel: every discovered binding grouped by tool, click a Hotkey cell to rebind via key capture, right-click to reset to default. Conflicts are flagged in the Status column.

# Hub

Package `FNS_Hub`.

The FNS button in TouchDesigner's main-menu bar and the one-stop manager window behind it: the Toolbar, Navbar and Main Menu configurators as tabs, the console, and any tab a tool contributes. Drop a panel COMP on the button to register it into a surface.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.16
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-hub/

## What it does

- **Open the hub**: Left-click the FNS button in the main-menu bar, or run Open FNS Hub from quick-launch, and the hub opens on the tab you were last on.
- **Jump to any tab from the FNS button**: Right-click the FNS button to jump to any tab or console page, bring a hidden tab back, switch Perform Mode, or open the docs.
- **Toolbar configurator**: Reorder, group, hide and show the widgets on TouchDesigner's bookmark bar, and add dividers between them.
- **Navbar configurator**: Reorder pane-bar items, flip them between the left and right side, and show, hide or group them.
- **Main menu configurator**: Arrange the main-menu bar with TouchDesigner's own items included, so your entries can sit between them.
- **Reorder OP Create contributions**: Reorder what tools add to the OP Create dialog, or switch a contribution off without uninstalling its tool.
- **Network overlay layout**: Reorder, show and hide what tools draw on the network editor, and move each corner list to another corner.
- **Console tab**: The toolkit's web console renders inside the hub, and its browser runs only while the tab is shown.
- **Commands tab**: Lists every command the command registry serves, hidden and built-in ones included, to star or hide.
- **Tool tabs**: The larger tool UIs, such as the OSC and MIDI mappers, sit in the same window, exactly the ones you have installed.
- **Arrange and hide tabs**: Drag tabs into your order, hide one from its tool's Shown in Hub parameter, and pick a wrapping or single-row tab bar; the layout roams with your settings.
- **Perform Mode**: Stops the tools that only serve the network editor for a show, turns the FNS button red, and brings everything back as it was. Follows TouchDesigner's Perform Mode by default.
- **Drop to register**: Drop a panel COMP on the FNS button, pick a surface, and it gets a self-registering host and appears there at once.
- **Open a tab from Python**: `op.FNS_HUBREGISTRY.Open(tab='navbar')` opens the hub on a tab by its canonical name, contributed tabs included.
- **Contribute a tab**: A tool carrying a stamped FNS_HubRegistry host gets a tab showing itself, an inner panel, an operator in an OP Viewer, or a parameter page.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. A child of the toolkit root, reached as `op.FNS.op('FNS_Hub')`; its promoted methods are called on that COMP.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: Whether any of the dragged items is a panel COMP the Hub can show as a tab.
- `Close()`: Close the Hub window and un-expose every tab.
- `HiddenTabs()`: Registered tabs currently hidden (the right-click menu offers them back).
- `OnActivetabChanged(name)`: The Active Tab par changed from outside (a roamed value landing after boot, or a script) -- follow it.
- `OnParChange(name, value)`: Called by the parameter execute when Activetab or Tabbar changes.
- `OnPulse(name)`: Called by the parameter execute for the Open and Refreshtabs pulses.
- `OnTabReorder(fromIndex, toIndex)`: Move a tab on the bar: the order persists on Tab User Order.
- `OnTabSelected(name)`: A tab on the bar was clicked (tabbar/tabs_exec).
- `Open(tab=None)`: Open the window; `tab` = a canonical name to switch to (a hidden tab is shown again first).
- `OpenHub()`: Open the FNS Hub window: every registry's configurator, the console, and any tab a tool contributes.
- `OpenMainMenuConfigurator()`: Open FNS Hub on the Main Menu tab (the configurator lives in the hub).
- `OpenMenu()`: Right-click on the FNS button: jump straight to a tab, to one of the console's pages, toggle FNSTools Perform Mode, or go to the documentation, the website or the Patreon join page.
- `OpenTabParameters(index)`: The owning tool's parameter window (the mappers are configured there), from a tab's right-click menu.
- `PerformOn()`: State chip for TogglePerform: the toolkit root's Perform Mode (docs/PerformMode.md).
- `RefreshTabs()`: Rebuild the folder-tab bar from the registry and show the active tab.
- `RouteDrop(items)`: Drop entry point (drop_callbacks).
- `ShowTab(name, displayed=True)`: Show or hide a Hub tab by canonical name; the choice roams with the layout.
- `Tabs()`: The shown tabs, in bar order (dicts from FNS_HubRegistry.Tabs).
- `TogglePerform()`: Toggle FNSTools Perform Mode: the tools that only serve the network editor stop, and come back as they were.

## Commands

# HubRegistry

Package `FNS_HubRegistry`.

The registry behind Hub's tab bar: tools contribute native panels, viewers or parameter pages as hub tabs. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.7
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-hubregistry/

## What it does

- **Self-healing Hub tabs**: Keeps one entry per Hub tab with its label, order and visibility, puts a mirror or viewer in the hub for each, and removes tabs whose tool is gone.
- **Arrange tabs**: Drag a tab onto another tab to reorder them; the order roams with your settings.
- **Rename a tab**: Tab Label on the tool's Registry page gives its tab a different label.
- **Hide a tab**: Hiding a tab is written back to its tool's Shown in Hub parameter, so it stays hidden across projects until you show it again.
- **Contribute a tab through a host**: A host copy names the tab: the tool's own panel, a panel inside the tool, or an OP Viewer of a DAT, CHOP, TOP, SOP, POP or MAT.
- **Parameter page tabs**: Tab Parameters shows a Parameter COMP view of chosen pages of the tool, or every page with `*`, as a Hub tab.
- **Python tab API**: RegisterTab(), Tabs(), SetTabDisplayed(), Open(tab=) and OpenDocs() register, list, show and open Hub tabs from Python.
- **Tab exposure callback**: An extension implementing OnHubExposure(exposed) learns when its tab is shown; a palette Web Browser has its Active switched for it.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_HUBREGISTRY` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: True when at least one dropped item could become a host here.
- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `Open(tab=None)`: Open FNS_Hub, on `tab` (a canonical name) when given.
- `OpenDocs(canonical)`: Open a tab's registered help page, if it has one.
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `RegisterTab(comp, canonical, content=None, params='', label='', order=50, displayed=True, help_url='', source_registry=None)`: Publish a tab.
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `SetTabDisplayed(canonical, displayed)`: Show or hide a tab.
- `StampHost(target_comp, canonical_name=None, autoregister=True, promote_pars=True, par_values=None)`: Copy THIS master into `target_comp` as a configured host.
- `Tabs(include_hidden=False)`: Every live tab in order (an entry whose content is gone is skipped, never shown broken).
- `ToggleGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: flip a group; returns the new state.
- `UnregisterPanel(canonical)`: Remove a contributed Hub tab and resync the tab bar (forwarded to the /sys global).
- `UnregisterTab(canonical)`: Remove a contributed Hub tab and resync the tab bar (forwarded to the /sys global).

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Registration

- **Tool COMP** (`par.Comp`, COMP), default `..`: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). It names the hub's mirror (hubtab_<name>). Leave empty to use the tool COMP name.
- **Tab Content** (`par.Tabcontent`, OP): What the tab shows. Empty = the tool COMP itself (it must be a panel). A panel COMP anywhere inside the tool is mirrored into the hub; a DAT/CHOP/TOP/SOP/POP is shown through an OP Viewer. Ignored when Tab Parameters is set.
- **Tab Parameters** (`par.Tabparams`, Str): Show a parameter view of the tool COMP instead of a panel: the page scope to display (e.g. 'Settings', or * for every page). Empty = not a parameter tab.
- **Show in Hub** (`par.Autoregister`, Toggle), default `on`: Publish this tab into FNS_Hub while the component exists. Off = the tool shows nothing in the hub and its panel stays wherever it lives.
- **Register** (`par.Register`, Pulse): Publish once into the hub, even if Show in Hub is off.
- **Unregister** (`par.Unregister`, Pulse): Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

- **Open Hub** (`par.Open`, Pulse): Open FNS_Hub (the toolkit's one-stop manager window) on this host's tab.

A toolbar reminder to drink water at an interval you set. Off by default.

- Category: Miscellaneous
- Version: 3.2.11
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-hydrohomie/

## What it does

- **Drink water reminder**: A small alert icon pulses on the toolbar at each interval, 45 minutes by default; click it away until the next one.

- `Show` (attribute)
- `Toggle()`: Show or hide the hydration reminder overlay.

- **Set HydroHomie interval** (id `setinterval`): Set the hydration reminder interval in minutes. Method `SetInterval`. Params: `minutes: float = 45`.

None.

None.

# OpFamily

Package `FNS_OpFamily`.

The FNS tab in the OP Create dialog: an operator family whose members are FNS tools placed from the store as one node each, with stubs for projects that travel and in-place updates that keep retained parameters and state. Built with TDFam.

- Category: Core
- Version: 0.1.12
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-opfamily/

## What it does

- **Create FNS tools from OP Create**: Adds an FNS tab beside COMP, TOP, CHOP and the others; each entry places an FNS tool into the current network as one operator.
- **Remove the FNS tab**: Pick Tools, the FNS Tab in OP Create switch or Remove Operator Family take the tab away, the choice sticks, and the switch brings it back.
- **Members mirrored from the store**: The tab lists exactly the members this machine's store holds, kept in step by the updater, and the same folder shows up in the Palette.
- **Replace a stock operator with a member**: A member can also be offered in place of a stock operator, such as Random when you create a Noise CHOP with the alternatives shortcut held.
- **Stub operators for projects that travel**: Placed members become light placeholders that keep their wiring, position, retained parameters and state, and come back as the real operators wherever the family is installed.
- **Update placed operators in place**: Upgrades every placed member to the newest version in the family folder, keeping its retained parameters and state.
- **Sync, stub and update from quick-launch**: Stub, replace, update and resync from quick-launch without dialogs, for the whole project or only the network you are in.
- **Manifest-declared retention**: Each member's manifest declares which parameters and which state survive a stub or an update.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. A child of the toolkit root, reached as `op.FNS.op('FNS_OpFamily')`; its promoted methods are called on that COMP.

## Promoted API

- `AssignedCallbacks` (attribute)
- `Config` (attribute)
- `CreateCallbackDat(owner, template)`: Create a callbacks DAT from template if not already set.
- `DoCallback(callbackName, callbackInfo=None)`: Execute a chained callback - calls BOTH assigned callback and DAT callback.
- `ExportConfig(path: str = None)`: Export config to JSON.
- `FamilyName` (property): The family's name, as a dependency.
- `FindOps(type=None, name=None, path=None, depth=None, maxDepth=None, tags=[], allTags=False, parValue=None, parExpr=None, parName=None, key=None, include_stubs=True, network=None)`: Find placed operators of this family.
- `FolderCache` (property): The cached listing of the family folder's operators, as a dependency.
- `GetMasterOps()`: Get all available operators in this family with full metadata.
- `GetOpSource(lookup_name: str)`: Get operator source for a given name.
- `ImportConfig(source: str | dict)`: Import config from JSON.
- `Install(install: bool = None)`: Install or uninstall the family.
- `InvalidateCallbackCache()`: Force cache refresh on next DoCallback.
- `PassTarget` (attribute)
- `PlaceOp(target, op_type, name=None, x=None, y=None)`: Programmatically place an operator into a target COMP.
- `Properties` (attribute)
- `RemoveOperatorFamily()`: Take the FNS tab out of the OP Create dialog, the tools staying installed; the installer removes it a frame later.
- `ReplaceFamilyStubs(only_current_network: bool = False)`: Bring every FNS stub back as the full operator from the family folder; returns the count and names what the folder lacks.
- `StubFamilyOperators(only_current_network: bool = False)`: Turn every placed FNS operator into a light stub that keeps its wiring and retained parameters; returns the count.
- `StubOp(comp)`: Create a lightweight stub from a placed operator.
- `SyncFamilyFromStore()`: Mirror the store's family members into the family folder now, through FNS_Updater.
- `UpdateFamilyOperators(only_current_network: bool = False)`: Upgrade placed FNS operators to the family folder's newest version, keeping retained parameters and state.
- `UpdateOp(comp)`: Update a single operator to the newest version.

## Commands

- **Remove Operator Family** (id `removeoperatorfamily`): Take the FNS tab out of the OP Create dialog and keep it off; your FNS tools stay installed. Pick Tools turns it back on Method `RemoveOperatorFamily`.
- **Replace Family Stubs** (id `replacefamilystubs`): Bring every FNS stub back as the full operator from the family folder Method `ReplaceFamilyStubs`. Params: `only_current_network: toggle = False`.
- **Stub Family Operators** (id `stubfamilyoperators`): Turn every placed FNS operator into a light stub that keeps its wiring and retained parameters Method `StubFamilyOperators`. Params: `only_current_network: toggle = False`.
- **Sync Family From Store** (id `syncfamilyfromstore`): Mirror the store's family members into the family folder now Method `SyncFamilyFromStore`.
- **Update Family Operators** (id `updatefamilyoperators`): Upgrade placed FNS operators to the newest version in the family folder, keeping retained parameters and state Method `UpdateFamilyOperators`. Params: `only_current_network: toggle = False`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`

## Parameters

### Family

- **Family Name** (`par.Family`, Str): The family name: the tab the operators appear under in the OP Create dialog.
- **Version** (`par.Version`, Str): The version of the family registry.
- **Install** (`par.Install`, Toggle), default `on`: Install the family into the OP Create dialog.
- **Install On Start** (`par.Installonstart`, Toggle), default `on`: Install the family every time the project opens.
- **Color** (`par.Color`, RGBA x3), default `0.569`: The family's colour in the OP Create dialog and on its operators.
- **Index** (`par.Index`, Int), default `9`: Position of the family's tab among the OP Create dialog's tabs.
- **Compatible Op Families** (`par.Compatibletypes`, StrMenu), menu `COMP`, `TOP`, `CHOP`, `SOP`, `POP`, `MAT`, `DAT`, `FNS`: Which operator families the family's operators connect to, for filtering in the dialog.
- **Op Comp** (`par.Opcomp`, COMP): The COMP holding the family's operators.
- **Create Op Comp** (`par.Createopcomp`, Pulse): Create an empty COMP for the family's operators and point Op Comp at it.
- ** [ .tox ] Op Folder** (`par.Opfolder`, Folder): A folder of .tox operators to add to the family.
- **Color .tox from Folder** (`par.Colorfileops`, Toggle), default `off`: Colour the operators loaded from the folder in the family colour.
- **Version Regex Match** (`par.Namingconvention`, StrMenu), menu `(.+)_v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\.tox$`, `(.+)_(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\.tox$`, `(.+)-(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\.tox$`, `No versioning`: How version numbers are read from .tox file names.
- **Ensure Manifests** (`par.Ensuremanifests`, Pulse): Give every operator in the family a manifest if it lacks one.
- **FamUI COMP** (`par.Famuicomp`, COMP): The COMP that draws the family's UI in the dialog.

### Stubs

- **Create Stubs For All** (`par.Createstuball`, Pulse): Create a stub for every operator in the family.
- **Replace Stubs For All** (`par.Replacestuball`, Pulse): Replace every stub in the project with the current operator.
- **Update All** (`par.Updateall`, Pulse): Update every family operator in the project to the current version.
- **Target Op** (`par.Targetop`, OP): Operator to stub or stub to replace
- **Create Stub For Op** (`par.Createstubop`, Pulse): Create stub for target operator
- **Replace Stub For Op** (`par.Replacestubop`, Pulse): Replace target stub with full operator
- **Update Op** (`par.Updateop`, Pulse): Update the selected operator to the current version.
- **Target Comp** (`par.Targetcomp`, OP): Network container to process
- **Create Stubs In Comp** (`par.Createstubscomp`, Pulse): Stub all operators in target network
- **Replace Stubs In Comp** (`par.Replacestubcomp`, Pulse): Regenerate all stubs in target network
- **Update Ops In Comp** (`par.Updatecomp`, Pulse): Update every family operator inside a COMP.
- **Target Type** (`par.Targettype`, StrMenu): The operator type Update Type acts on.
- **Update Type** (`par.Updatetype`, Pulse): Update every placed operator of Target Type.

### Callbacks

- **Callback DAT** (`par.Callbackdat`, DAT): The DAT holding the family's callbacks.
- **Create Callbacks** (`par.Createcallbacks`, Pulse): Create a callbacks DAT from the template and point Callback DAT at it.

### About

- **About** (`par.About`, Pulse): Show the about text.
- **License** (`par.License`, Pulse): Show the license.
- **Dev Mode** (`par.Devmode`, Toggle), default `off`: Development mode, for authoring the family itself.
- **Support** (`par.Tdfamcreators0support`, Pulse): Open the support page of a TDFam creator.
- **Support** (`par.Tdfamcreators1support`, Pulse): Open the support page of a TDFam creator.

# OpMenuMods

Package `FNS_OpMenuMods`.

OP Create dialog extras: IO filter buttons, your own search keywords per operator type, and acronym search (type m f o for Movie File Out).

- Category: Interface
- Version: 3.2.11
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-opmenumods/

## What it does

- **Filter IO operators**: Buttons at the top right of the OP Create dialog show only IO operators, hide them, or show everything.
- **Custom search keywords**: Give any operator type your own search words, so typing music finds Audio File In and webcam finds Video Device In.
- **Keyword table in Hub**: The keywords live in one table, edited from the SearchWords tab of Hub and synced across project files.
- **Acronym search**: Type the start of each word of an operator's name, such as m f o, to find Movie File Out.
- **Remove cleanly, shared with other tools**: The mods apply through OpMenuRegistry, so several tools can decorate the dialog together and it returns to stock when they are removed.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_OPMOD` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `ResyncOpMenu()`: Re-collect the op-menu contributions from all tools.

## Commands

- **Resync op menu** (id `resyncopmenu`): Re-collect the op-menu contributions from all tools. Method `ResyncOpMenu`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_HubRegistry`
- `FNS_OpMenuRegistry`

## Parameters

### IO Filter

- **IO Filter Active** (`par.Iofilteractive`, Toggle), default `on`: Add Greg Hermanovic's IO filter buttons to the top right of the OP Create dialog: IO shows only operators that talk to something outside TouchDesigner, -IO hides them, All is the default.

# OpMenuRegistry

Package `FNS_OpMenuRegistry`.

OP Create dialog surface registry: search words, row decorations, right-click items, filter stages. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.8
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-opmenuregistry/

## What it does

- **Shared OP Create dialog surface**: Arbitrates between the tools that change the OP Create dialog, and the dialog goes back to stock when those tools are removed.
- **Arrange contributions in Hub**: Hub's OpMenu tab reorders what the tools add to the dialog and switches any contribution off without uninstalling its tool.
- **Replace a stock operator with an alternative**: Create a stock operator type with the alternatives shortcut held and installed alternatives are offered; one is placed with its wiring restored, several open a picker.
- **Alternatives from the store**: Alternatives from tools downloaded to your store but not in the project are offered below a divider and placed from disk; >> marks such types.
- **Search word contributions**: Tools add extra words that match an operator type, so searching music finds Audio File In.
- **Row decorations**: Tools relabel rows in the operator list, such as the >>> OpTemplates puts beside every type you have a template for.
- **Right-click menu items**: Tools add entries after TouchDesigner's own three in the dialog's right-click menu, such as OpTemplates' Edit Templates.
- **Filter-chain stages**: Tools splice Script DATs into the operator list's filter chain to filter or rewrite the list itself.
- **Panel injection**: Tools wire Panel COMPs into the dialog at a named anchor.
- **Callbacks DAT inside each tool**: A tool's whole contribution is one opmenu_callbacks DAT inside the tool, so its menu behaviour travels in its own .tox.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_OPMENUREGISTRY` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: True when at least one dropped item could become a host here.
- `Alternatives` (property): Merged {opType: [alternative, ...]} from every contributor.
- `Contributors` (property): Manager API: snapshot of all registered contributor entries.
- `CreateCallbacks()`: Spawn an `opmenu_callbacks` DAT into this host's tool and point the host's Callback parameter at it.
- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `DecorateLabel(optype, label)`: Run every contributor's row decorator over a node-table label.
- `Decorators` (property): [(canonical, fn)] label decorators, resolved ONCE.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `InvokeMenuItem(index, optype)`: Dispatch a right-click menu click (index is already offset past TD's stock items) back to the tool that published it.
- `MarkAlternatives(optype, label)`: Append the alternatives mark to one node-table label.
- `MenuItems` (property): [(canonical, label)] appended after TD's stock right-click items.
- `OpenDocs(canonical_name)`: Open the tool's self-reported wiki/help page, if it has one.
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `PlaceAlternative(orig_op, alternative)`: Replace `orig_op` in place with one alternative (a dict from Alternatives, or a bare OP), restoring its input and output wiring.
- `RefreshStoreAlternatives()`: Drop the cached store scan; the next read rescans the folder.
- `RegisterContributor(comp, canonical_name, callback=None, order=None, display=True, source_registry=None, help_url=None, panel=None, panel_anchor=None)`: Publish a COMP's op-menu contributions under canonical_name.
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `Resync()`: Public: re-apply the whole surface now.
- `SearchWords` (property): Merged {opType: [word, ...]} from every contributor.
- `SetContributorDisplay(canonical_name, visible)`: Manager API: enable or disable a tool's contributions.
- `SetContributorOrder(canonical_name, order)`: Manager API: reorder a contributor's menu items.
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `StampHost(target_comp, canonical_name=None, autoregister=True, promote_pars=True, par_values=None)`: Copy THIS master into `target_comp` as a configured host.
- `ToggleGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: flip a group; returns the new state.
- `UnregisterContributor(canonical_name)`: Remove a contributor's menu items, search words and alternatives and resync the dialog (forwarded to the /sys global).
- `UnregisterPanel(canonical_name)`: RegistryBase's teardown name for UnregisterContributor.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Registration

- **Widget COMP** (`par.Comp`, COMP), default `..`: Panel COMP published as the toolbar widget. Defaults to the parent component.
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique name for this widget in the global toolbar registry.
- **Callback DAT** (`par.Callback`, DAT): Optional DAT with toolbar callbacks for this widget.
- **Create Callbacks** (`par.Createcallbacks`, Pulse): Spawn an 'opmenu_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.
- **Panel** (`par.Panel`, COMP): A Panel COMP to inject into /ui/dialogs/menu_op. The zero-code way to contribute a panel, with no callbacks DAT needed. Combined with anything onPanels() returns, not overridden by it.
- **Panel Anchor** (`par.Panelanchor`, Str), default `searchpanel`: Name of a panel inside /ui/dialogs/menu_op whose output the injected panel's input is wired to. Without it the panel drops out of the dialog's layout flow. Default: searchpanel.
- **Auto-register** (`par.Autoregister`, Toggle), default `off`: When on, keep this widget published into the global toolbar registry while this component exists.
- **Register** (`par.Register`, Pulse): Publish once into the global toolbar registry, even if Auto-register is off.
- **Unregister** (`par.Unregister`, Pulse): Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.
- **Registration Status** (`par.Regstatus`, Str): Read-only status of this host registration.
- **Contribution Order** (`par.Menuorder`, Int), default `-1`: Preferred order among registered widgets, managed by the global registry. -1 = no preference (append at the end).
- **Displayed** (`par.Displayed`, Toggle), default `on`: Default visibility of the widget in the toolbar (managed by the global registry).
- **Help URL** (`par.Helpurl`, Str): The tool's wiki/help page opened from the Configurator (right-click the Name cell). Leave empty to auto-discover from a docsHelper COMP (its Url par) inside the registered panel or its parent.
- **Promote Parameters** (`par.Promotepars`, Toggle), default `on`: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.
- **Pre-Save Heal** (`par.Presaveheal`, Toggle), default `on`: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

### Alternatives

- **Alternatives Shortcut** (`par.Shortcutalternatives`, Str), default `alt ctrl`: Modifier keys to hold while creating an operator to be offered the alternatives registered for its type (space-separated: alt, ctrl, shift, cmd). Without the keys the operator is created as normal. Applies on the /sys global; the master holds the value the global is promoted with.

# OpTemplates

Package `FNS_OpTemplates`.

A library of preconfigured operator templates to drop into a network.

- Category: Network
- Version: 3.2.14
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-optemplates/

## What it does

- **Template by drag and drop**: Drop an operator set up the way you like onto the toolbar icon and it becomes a template for its type.
- **Place a template on create**: Hold the alternatives shortcut (`Ctrl+Alt` by default) while placing an operator marked >>> in the OP Create dialog, and your template goes down in its place with the wiring kept.
- **Variants of one operator type**: Keep as many named variants of one operator type as you like and pick one from a menu as you place it.
- **Operator chains as templates**: Operators wired after the template operator are placed together with it, such as the shipped LFO, Math and Null.
- **Network snippets as templates**: A Base COMP in the type's template holds a whole network, such as a Render TOP with its geometry, camera and light, placed as one template.
- **Substitute a COMP for the operator**: A Base COMP inside a snippet's Base COMP makes the template land as that COMP.
- **Insert into a connection**: Templates, chains and networks drop into an existing wire, with In and Out operators marking where a network connects.
- **Shared alternatives menu**: Other tools that offer themselves for the same operator type are listed beside your templates, with tools from your store below a divider.
- **Global or per-project library**: Keep one library for every project on the machine or one inside the project file, or follow the toolkit's Config Scope.
- **Push project templates to global**: Push To Global copies the project set to the global file whenever you like, asking first when the file exists.
- **Save the templates**: Under global scope, middle-click the toolbar icon or press Save Templates; under project scope, saving the project saves them.
- **Open the library**: Left-click the toolbar icon, or run Open templates from quick-launch, to browse or edit the library in a floating network editor.
- **Edit one type's templates**: Right-click a type in the OP Create dialog and pick Edit Templates... to work on its templates.
- **Starter set**: Ships with templates for 18 operator types to start from.
- **Library kept across upgrades**: On the first start after an upgrade it finds the newest library you saved under an older name, and keeps the file it replaces beside it.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_OPTEMPLATES` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `AddToTemplates()`: Save the current selection as a new template.
- `ColorBaseCOMPbyName(_op)`: Color a template base by the operator family its name contains.
- `DropOp(_op)`: Store a dropped operator as a template for its operator type.
- `ExternalChange(onSave=False, startup=False, enable=None)`: Retired with the External toggle; the scope decides now.
- `ExternalPath` (property): The global library file's path, evaluated.
- `ExternalPathExpr(name=None)`: The expression for the global library file's path under the palette, for the externaltox parameter.
- `OnNewOp(_op: td.OP)`: Kept for callers; the engine lives in FNS_OpMenuRegistry now.
- `OnTemplatesUpdate(new_ops)`: Called when the templates network changes: refresh the cache and color the new bases.
- `OpenTemplateBase(optype)`: Open the template base of an operator type in a floating network editor, creating it when needed.
- `OpenTemplates()`: Open the OP templates browser (floating).
- `OpenTemplatesFloating()`: Open the templates network in a floating network editor.
- `PlaceTemplate(orig_op=None, template_ops=None)`: Place a template through the registry (kept for the popMenu callbacks and any external caller).
- `PushToGlobal()`: Write the active library to the palette file (asks before an overwrite).
- `RefreshCachedTemplates()`: Drop the cached Templates listing so the next read rebuilds it.
- `RefreshTemplates()`: Reload the active library: from the palette file under global scope; the project library has nothing to reload, its cache is refreshed.
- `RefreshTemplatesCmd()`: Reload the templates from disk.
- `SaveTemplates()`: Write the templates tox to disk.
- `TemplateSave()`: Persist the active library: the palette file under global scope, the project itself under project scope.

## Commands

- **Add selection to templates** (id `addtotemplates`): Save the current selection as a new template. Method `AddToTemplates`.
- **Open templates** (id `opentemplates`): Open the OP templates browser (floating). Method `OpenTemplates`.
- **Refresh templates** (id `refreshtemplatescmd`): Reload the templates from disk. Method `RefreshTemplatesCmd`.
- **Save templates** (id `savetemplates`): Write the templates tox to disk. Method `SaveTemplates`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

- `analyzeCHOP`
- `analyzeTOP`
- `audiodeviceinCHOP`
- `baseCOMP`
- `circleTOP`
- `compTOP`
- `dattoCHOP`
- `displaceTOP`
- `filterCHOP`
- `lfoCHOP`
- `limitCHOP`
- `moviefileoutTOP`
- `noiseTOP`
- `rampTOP`
- `renderTOP`
- `scurveCHOP`
- `speedCHOP`
- `triggerCHOP`

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_OpMenuRegistry`
- `FNS_ToolbarRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Root** (`par.Target`, COMP), default `x`: The component whose network is watched for newly created operators. '/' watches the whole project; narrow it if you want templates to apply in one branch only.
- **Library Scope** (`par.Libraryscope`, Menu), default `follow`, menu `follow`, `global`, `project`: Where the active templates library lives. Global: one .tox in your user palette folder, shared by every project on this machine. Project: a component at the network root outside FNSTools, saved with this .toe and kept across toolkit updates. Follow: whatever the toolkit's Config Scope says. A missing library is created from the set that is loaded now; the shipped templates are only the seed.
- **Library Folder** (`par.Libraryfolder`, Str): Folder under <user palette>/FNSTools that holds the global library. Empty uses OpTemplates, which is right for everyone except a development project that must keep its curated set apart from the one it uses day to day. Global scope only; cleared on export, so it never ships.
- **Templates** (`par.Templates`, COMP): The library the scope resolved to. Read-only: change Library Scope instead.
- **Open Templates** (`par.Opentemplates`, Pulse): Open the templates component in a floating network, to add or edit templates by hand.
- **Save Templates** (`par.Savetemplates`, Pulse): Write the templates to disk: to the external .tox when External is on, otherwise by saving the project. It confirms first, because it overwrites what is already there.
- **Push To Global** (`par.Pushtoglobal`, Pulse): Write the active library to the global palette file, so a set built in this project becomes the one every project on this machine loads. Asks before overwriting an existing file.
- **Refresh Templates** (`par.Refreshtemplates`, Pulse): Reload the templates component from its external .tox, discarding unsaved edits made in this session.
- **Keys** (`par.Keys`, Str): Mirrors the Alternatives Shortcut on FNS_OpMenuRegistry, which is where the alternatives are offered from now. Change it there.

# OpToClipboard

Package `FNS_OpToClipboard`.

Copy the selected operator's reference to the system clipboard, ready to paste into an expression.

- Category: Parameters
- Version: 3.2.9
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-optoclipboard/

## What it does

- **Copy an operator reference**: `Ctrl+Shift+C` copies a reference to the selected operator, ready to paste into an expression.
- **Resolve the right path wherever you paste**: The pasted reference resolves to the right relative or shortcut path for the operator you paste it into.
- **Copy a parameter reference**: Over a parameter the same shortcut copies that parameter, or the whole group when over the name of a row with several fields.
- **Toggle the tool from quick-launch**: Toggle OpToClipboard switches the tool on and off, and Copy op to clipboard does the same as the key.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. A child of the toolkit root, reached as `op.FNS.op('FNS_OpToClipboard')`; its promoted methods are called on that COMP.

## Promoted API

- `CopyOpToClipboard()`: Copy the current operator to the OS clipboard.
- `OnCopy()`: Copy a reference to the hovered parameter, or to the current operator, to the clipboard; called by the hotkey.
- `OnRolloverPar(_op_str, _par_str, _expr)`: Called when a parameter is hovered: a pasted reference to the copied operator in its expression is rewritten as a relative path.
- `ToggleActive()`: Enable or disable OpToClipboard.

## Commands

- **Copy op to clipboard** (id `copyoptoclipboard`): Copy the current operator to the OS clipboard. Method `CopyOpToClipboard`.
- **Toggle OpToClipboard** (id `toggleactive`): Enable or disable OpToClipboard. Method `ToggleActive`.

## Hotkeys

- `shift.ctrl.c` (`shortcuts` on `keyboardin1`)

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Active** (`par.Active`, Toggle), default `on`: Turn OpToClipboard on or off. When on, the copy shortcut puts the selected operator's reference on the clipboard ready to paste into an expression. Off leaves the component installed but idle.
- **Shortcut** (`par.Shortcut`, Str): Hotkey that copies the selected operator's reference to the clipboard.

# OpenExt

Package `FNS_OpenExt`.

Open an operator's extension source quickly.

- Category: Developer
- Version: 3.2.8
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-openext/

## What it does

- **Open extension by hotkey**: `Ctrl+E` on a COMP opens its first promoted extension in the external editor TouchDesigner is set to use; on a COMP without one nothing happens.
- **Command palette entry**: Also published as the quick-launch command Open extension of current, so it runs from the command palette without the hotkey.
- **Sync edits back with VSCodeTools**: With the extension synced to a file by VSCodeTools, every save in your editor lands back in the running component.

## Reach it

# Output

Package `FNS_Output`.

A toolbar button for the perform window: drop an operator to route it, click to open or close, and switch NDI and Spout/Syphon streaming of the same window.

- Category: Show & output
- Version: 3.2.10
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-output/

## What it does

- **Drop to set the Window Operator**: Dropping a TOP or a COMP on the toolbar button makes it the Window Operator of the /perform window, without opening the Window COMP's parameters.
- **Open the perform window**: Left-clicking the button opens the perform window.
- **NDI streaming**: The right-click popup streams the perform window over NDI to machines on the same network, under NDI Source Name; on by default.
- **Spout and Syphon streaming**: The same popup sends the perform window to other applications on the machine over Spout, or Syphon on macOS, under Sender Name; on by default.
- **Toggle streams from quick-launch**: Switch the NDI and Spout/Syphon streams on and off from quick-launch.
- **Choose the Window COMP**: The button's Perform parameter sets which Window COMP the drop and the click go to, taking effect on the next drop with nothing to re-install.

- `PerformWindowOpen()`: Whether the perform window is open.

- `ToggleNdi()`: Enable or disable the NDI output stream.
- `TogglePerformWindow()`: Open or close the FNS perform output window.
