# OverlayRegistry

Package `FNS_OverlayRegistry`.

One overlay over the network editor you are working in, composited from every tool that draws there: each tool hands over its own image, and this registry fits it over your view, stacks it with the rest and shows it above the nodes, without touching your network's display flags or annotations.

- Category: Core
- Version: 0.2.4
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-overlayregistry/

## What it does

- **Stack every tool's drawing in one overlay**: Stacks every tool's drawing into one image shown above the nodes of the network editor you work in; with nothing drawing, nothing runs.
- **Follows the view**: Pan, zoom or open another network and the overlay follows, keeping everything in place at any zoom and sharp on high DPI screens.
- **Leaves your network untouched**: Switches no display flag, dims no annotation, and is taken out before every project save.
- **Corner widgets**: Tools can pin small clickable panels to a corner of the network editor that keep their size at any zoom and stack without overlapping.
- **Manage layers and widgets in Hub**: FNS_Hub's Overlay tab lists every layer and widget: reorder them, hide one without switching its tool off, or move a widget to another corner.
- **Publish a layer**: A tool hands over one TOP through a host copy of the registry, or from Python with RegisterWidget(), and the registry composites it with the rest.
- **View data for layers**: The View page and View() give the covered network rectangle, render resolution, units per pixel and zoom; NetworkToPixel() converts network positions to pixels.
- **Panel widget API**: RegisterPanelWidget() pins a tool's panel COMP to a corner with an order and margin; UnregisterPanelWidget() takes it away.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_OVERLAYREGISTRY` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: True when at least one dropped item could become a host here.
- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `Cursor()`: The mouse over a network editor as (network, x, y) in network units, or None when it is over no network editor of this TD's main window.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `LayerEntries()`: Every registered layer as {canonical: entry}, bottom first: panel_path, display (the user's), active (the tool's), menu_order, source_registry (its host).
- `NetworkToPixel(x, y)`: A point in network units to layer pixels (origin bottom left).
- `Overlay` (property): The annotation showing the composite, or None.
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `PanelWidgets()`: The registered widget names.
- `RegisterPanelWidget(panel, canonical, anchor='topleft', order=None, margin=None, shown=True, active=True, tool=None, pars=None, at=None)`: Show `panel` (a panel COMP) as an interactive widget pinned to a corner of the network editor you work in, at its own size on screen.
- `RegisterWidget(widget_op, canonical_name, order=None, display=True, callback=None, source_registry=None, active=True)`: Publish a TOP as a layer of the network overlay under canonical_name.
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `StampHost(target_comp, canonical_name=None, autoregister=True, promote_pars=True, par_values=None)`: RegistryBase.StampHost, then shaped like every other registry host.
- `ToggleGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: flip a group; returns the new state.
- `UnregisterPanel(canonical_name)`: RegistryBase's teardown name for UnregisterWidget.
- `UnregisterPanelWidget(canonical)`: Take a widget off the network editor.
- `UnregisterWidget(canonical_name)`: Remove a layer from the overlay and recomposite (forwarded to the /sys global).
- `View()`: Everything a client layer needs to render, as one dict.
- `WidgetRect(canonical)`: (network, x, y, width, height) of a widget as placed now, in network units of the network it shows in, or None while it is not shown.
- `WidgetSpecs()`: Every registered widget as {canonical: spec}: panel_path, anchor, order, margin, shown, active, tool_path and pars (the overlay manager's view; a copy, editing it changes nothing).
- `WidgetTarget(canonical)`: The live layer TOP registered under `canonical`, or None.
- `Widgets()`: The registered names, bottom layer first.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Registration

- **Widget COMP** (`par.Comp`, COMP), default `..`: The tool this layer belongs to. Defaults to the parent component; it names the layer when Canonical Name is empty.
- **Layer TOP** (`par.Layer`, TOP): The TOP this tool adds to the network overlay. It renders over the registry's View (op.FNS_OVERLAYREGISTRY.View()), premultiplied, transparent where it draws nothing.
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique name for this layer in the overlay registry.
- **Callback DAT** (`par.Callback`, DAT): Optional DAT with find bar callbacks for this widget.
- **Auto-register** (`par.Autoregister`, Toggle), default `off`: When on, keep this widget published into the find bar registry while this component exists.
- **Register** (`par.Register`, Pulse): Publish once into the find bar registry, even if Auto-register is off.
- **Unregister** (`par.Unregister`, Pulse): Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.
- **Registration Status** (`par.Regstatus`, Str): Read-only status of this host registration.
- **Layer Order** (`par.Menuorder`, Int), default `-1`: Stacking order among layers: higher draws on top. -1 = no preference (bottom).
- **Displayed** (`par.Displayed`, Toggle), default `on`: Whether the layer is in the overlay. Bind it to the tool's own on switch.
- **Layer Active** (`par.Layeractive`, Toggle), default `off`: The tool's own half of whether its layer is drawn: an expression on the tool's on/off switch (Active unless the tool says otherwise). The layer shows only when this AND Displayed are on; Displayed is yours.
- **Promote Parameters** (`par.Promotepars`, Toggle), default `on`: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.
- **Pre-Save Heal** (`par.Presaveheal`, Toggle), default `on`: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

# PaletteRegistry

Package `FNS_PaletteRegistry`.

Contribute tabs to TouchDesigner's Palette Browser: a tool publishes a native panel COMP and it appears beside the stock Palette tab, sized to the slot and notified on every tab change.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.7
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-paletteregistry/

## What it does

- **Tabs in the Palette Browser**: Adds a tab strip above the Palette Browser's list, with TouchDesigner's own Palette tab first and one tab per contributed panel.
- **Stock palette left intact**: With nothing contributed the palette stays as TouchDesigner ships it; the strip appears with the first registration and goes with the last.
- **Switch back to the Palette tab**: SearchPalette's `Ctrl+Shift+F` switches to the stock Palette tab before focusing its search field; other tools can call ShowTab('palette') the same way.
- **Register a tab from a host**: A tool ships a small host copy whose Registration page sets the tab's tool, canonical name, panel, label, order and visibility.
- **Tab API from Python**: RegisterTab(), Tabs(), SetTabDisplayed(), ShowTab(), CurrentTab() and UnregisterTab() on op.FNS_PALETTEREGISTRY manage tabs from code.
- **Tab change callback**: An optional Callbacks DAT gets onPaletteTab(canonical, previous) on every tab change.
- **Panels fitted to the slot**: A registered panel is resized to the slot, restored when the tab goes away, and keeps its state across tab switches, Web Render included.
- **Extra tabs from one tool**: The Extra Tabs sequence adds one tab per block, and a block without its own panel reuses the first tab's panel.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_PALETTEREGISTRY` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `CurrentTab()`: The canonical name of the tab the palette shows now, the stock tab by default.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `PanelTarget(canonical)`: Live panel for a tab (the mirrors' selectpanel expression).
- `RegisterTab(comp, canonical, panel=None, label='', order=50, displayed=True, callback=None, source_registry=None)`: Publish a tab: `panel` (a panel COMP in the project) is shown in the Palette Browser under a tab named `label`.
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RemoveSurface()`: Take the strip and every mirror out of the dialog and show the stock palette.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `Resync()`: Rebuild the palette strip and the mirrors from the registered tabs.
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `SetTabDisplayed(canonical, displayed)`: Show or hide a contributed tab; written back to the contributing host's Displayed par (compare-before-set) so it persists with the tool.

No commands recorded for this package.

None.

None.

Nothing.

### Registration

- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). Leave empty to use the tool COMP name. "palette" is TD's own tab and cannot be taken.
- **Tab Panel** (`par.Panel`, PanelCOMP): The panel COMP shown when this tab is selected. Shown in place through a Select COMP, never copied, and sized to the tab slot by the registry (its w/h become slot expressions while registered). Defaults to the tool itself.

- **Registration Status** (`par.Regstatus`, Str): Read-only status of this host registration.
- **Shown in Palette** (`par.Displayed`, Toggle), default `on`: Show this tab on the Palette Browser's tab strip. Off keeps it registered but hidden; the registry writes its choice back here so it persists with the tool.

- **Help URL** (`par.Helpurl`, Str): The tool's wiki/help page. Informational; leave empty to skip.
- **Promote Parameters** (`par.Promotepars`, Toggle), default `on`: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound Registry page (Pl* pars). Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.
- **Pre-Save Heal** (`par.Presaveheal`, Toggle), default `on`: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.
- **Extra Tabs** (`par.Tab`, Sequence), default `0`: Additional tabs published by this one host. The Registration pars above define the FIRST tab; each block here adds one more, so a tool can put several tabs on the strip (optionally over the same panel) without stamping a second host.
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Tab0name`, Str): Unique name of this extra tab (letters, digits, _ -). Required; the block is skipped while it is empty. "palette" is TD's own tab and cannot be taken.
- **Tab Panel** (`par.Tab0source`, PanelCOMP): Panel COMP shown for this tab. Leave empty to reuse the Tab Panel above. That is how one panel serves several tabs, routed by onPaletteTab.
- **Tab Label** (`par.Tab0label`, Str): What the tab strip shows for this tab. Empty = the canonical name.
- **Tab Order** (`par.Tab0order`, Int), default `50`: Position on the strip after TD's own Palette tab. Contributions sort by this, then by label.
- **Shown in Palette** (`par.Tab0shown`, Toggle), default `on`: Show this tab on the strip. Off keeps it registered but hidden.

# PaneTypeRegistry

Package `FNS_PaneTypeRegistry`.

Named, persistent pane-type entries for TD's panebar: any COMP can appear in the pane-type dropdown and be recalled with configurable owner, type, window actions and callbacks.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.9
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-panetyperegistry/

## What it does

- **Recall a COMP from the pane-type dropdown**: A COMP joins the pane bar's pane-type dropdown; picking it turns the pane into that COMP with the entry's owner, pane type, window behaviour and callbacks.

None.

None.

Nothing.

- **Menu Order** (`par.Menuorder`, Int), default `-1`: Preferred order among registered panebar entries. -1 = no preference (append, default). 0 = first among custom entries, 1 = second, and so on. Built-in rows are not moved.

# ParRandomizer

Package `FNS_ParRandomizer`.

Randomize parameter values within range, for quick exploration.

# ParentHierarchy

Package `FNS_ParentHierarchy`.

Hover a parent in the pane-bar path with Alt to see its parent shortcut, global shortcut and internal operators, and Ctrl to see its custom parameters and values. Click any item to copy a reference to it. It works on the path you already have and adds no button of its own.

- Category: Network
- Version: 3.2.9
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-parenthierarchy/

## What it does

- **Shortcuts on Alt-hover**: Hold `Alt` over a COMP in the pane-bar path to see its parent shortcut, global shortcut and internal operators.
- **Parameter values on Ctrl-hover**: Hold `Ctrl` to see where each iop points and every custom parameter with its value; press `Ctrl` again to poll the values.

# ResetPLS

Package `FNS_ResetPLS`.

Reset stateful operators (feedback, cache, timers, counts) across the project, with a pattern-based exception list. Bound to ctrl+0.

- Category: Project
- Version: 3.2.11
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-resetpls/

## What it does

- **Restart every feedback loop and timer at once**: One press of `Ctrl+0`, the toolbar button or quick-launch pulses the reset of every matching operator in the project.
- **Operator type toggles**: Switch whole operator types in or out, from Feedback TOPs and Timer CHOPs to particle systems, solvers and MIDI In DATs.
- **Startup reset**: The project can reset itself once as it opens.
- **Rewind the timeline too**: A reset can also send the root timeline back to a chosen frame.
- **Search only part of a project**: Point the search at one component, and cap how deep it looks.
- **Exclude operators by path**: Leave named operators alone, with or without everything inside them.
- **Exceptions by pattern**: A pattern list such as `^*/presets*` for components that should never be reset; with Externalize Tables on, it follows you from project to project.
- **Custom components join the reset**: Your components and Script operators join the reset through a pulse named Reset or Resetpulse, and the list of names is yours to extend.
- **Callback on every reset**: Run your own Python on every reset, for anything a pulse cannot express.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_RPLS` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `EditCustomResetPars()`: Open the custom reset pars editor.
- `EditStaticExceptions()`: Open the static exceptions editor.
- `ResetGenerators()`: Pulse Reset on every enabled generator OP type (the panic button).

## Commands

- **Edit custom reset pars** (id `editcustomresetpars`): Open the custom reset pars editor. Method `EditCustomResetPars`.
- **Edit reset static exceptions** (id `editstaticexceptions`): Open the static exceptions editor. Method `EditStaticExceptions`.
- **Reset all generators** (id `resetgenerators`): Pulse Reset on every enabled generator OP type (the panic button). Method `ResetGenerators`.

## Hotkeys

- `cmd.0 ctrl.0` (`Shortcut` on `FNS_ResetPLS`)

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_ToolbarRegistry`

## Parameters

### Conf

- **Root** (`par.Root`, COMP), default `..`: Where the search for resettable operators starts. Everything under this component is considered, subject to Depth and the exception lists.
- **Limit Depth** (`par.Limitdepth`, Toggle), default `on`: Stop the search at a fixed number of levels below Root instead of walking the whole tree. Worth it in a big project where a full walk is slow.
- **Depth** (`par.Depth`, Int), default `1`: How many levels below Root to search, when Limit Depth is on.
- **Except** (`par.Except`, Str): Operators to leave alone, one pattern per entry. Everything else under Root is reset.
- **Exceptions Limit** (`par.Exceptionslimit`, Toggle), default `off`: For an excepted COMP, also skip everything inside it. Off resets its children even though the COMP itself is excepted.
- **Enable All OPtypes** (`par.Activeall`, Pulse): Switch on every operator-type toggle across the pages, so the reset covers everything this tool knows how to reset.
- **Disable All OPtypes** (`par.Disableall`, Pulse): Switch off every operator-type toggle, so the reset covers nothing until you pick types back.
- **Reset On Startup** (`par.Resetonstartup`, Toggle), default `off`: Fire the reset once, automatically, when the project opens.
- **Reset** (`par.Reset`, Pulse): Reset now: pulse the reset parameter of every included operator under Root. This is what the hotkey and the toolbar button do.
- **Reset Shortcut** (`par.Shortcut`, Str), default `cmd.0 ctrl.0`: Hotkey that pulses Global ResetPLS. Both the Windows and macOS combos are listed.

### TOP

- **Feedback** (`par.Feedbacktop`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Feedback TOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Cache** (`par.Cachetop`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Cache TOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Texture 3D** (`par.Texture3d`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Texture 3D TOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.

- **Script** (`par.Scripttop`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Script TOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else. Reset here means pulsing a custom parameter named Reset or Resetpulse. The list of names it looks for is editable under Misc, Edit Custom Reset Pars.

### CHOP

- **LFO** (`par.Lfo`, Toggle), default `off`: Include LFO CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Speed** (`par.Speed`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Speed CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Count** (`par.Count`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Count CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Timer** (`par.Timer`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Timer CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Filter** (`par.Filter`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Filter CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Lag** (`par.Lag`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Lag CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Audio File In** (`par.Audiofilein`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Audio File In CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Audio Oscillator** (`par.Audiooscillator`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Audio Oscillator CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.
- **Feedback** (`par.Feedbackchop`, Toggle), default `off`: Include Feedback CHOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.

# SearchFix

Package `FNS_SearchFix`.

Makes the network editor's find bar find things: any part of a name, case-insensitive, with wildcards, optionally fuzzy and inside child networks. Keeps the bar's arrows and Home toggle; a Legacy toggle brings TouchDesigner's own search back.

- Category: Network
- Version: 0.2.8
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-searchfix/

## What it does

- **Find any part of a name**: Finds operators by any part of their name in any case; typed spaces become underscores, and a text split into parts needs every part to match.
- **Wildcard patterns**: Patterns like `noise*`, `*out?` and `[ab]lur*` match whole names as in TouchDesigner's pattern fields, and a leading `^` inverts the match.
- **Fuzzy matching**: When switched on, also finds word initials, a typo or two, or the letters in order, listed after every plain hit.
- **Rank the best results first**: Exact names rank first, then names starting with the text, then word matches, then anywhere, with shallower operators before deeper ones.
- **Step through results**: The arrows step through results, the first is picked as you type, and with Home on the pane centres on the picked operator.
- **Deep search into child networks**: A Deep checkbox and depth field in each pane's bar search the networks inside the current one; picking a hit takes the pane into its network.
- **Restore TouchDesigner's own search**: A Legacy checkbox in the find bar brings back TouchDesigner's own search for every pane, and switching SearchFix off restores every bar as it was.
- **Close the bar from inside it**: The find bar shortcut also closes the bar while you are typing in it.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_SEARCHFIX` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `FillResults(scriptOp: 'scriptDAT')`: The script_results cook: one row per hit, its path relative to the search root.
- `PatchAll()`: Patch every find bar there is, or unpatch them all when Active is off.
- `Pick(fb: 'COMP', index: 'int')`: Make result `index` current and selected, entering its network if needed, and home on it when the bar's Home toggle is on.
- `RepatchFindBars()`: Apply the search to every find bar again, for example after TouchDesigner rebuilt one.
- `Search(root: 'COMP', text: 'str', legacy: 'bool' = False, fuzzy: 'bool' = False, depth: 'int' = 1, limit: 'int' = 500)`: Paths of the operators matching `text`, relative to `root`, best first.
- `Step(fb: 'COMP', delta: 'int')`: Back (-1) or forward (+1) through the results.
- `ToggleActive()`: Switch the Python find-bar search on or off; off is TouchDesigner's own find bar.
- `ToggleFuzzy()`: Also match loosely in the find bar: first letters of words, a typo or two.
- `ToggleLegacy()`: Search like TouchDesigner's own find bar: names that start with the text, case-sensitive.

## Commands

- **Repatch find bars** (id `repatchfindbars`): Apply the search to every find bar again, for example after TouchDesigner rebuilt one. Method `RepatchFindBars`.
- **Toggle SearchFix** (id `toggleactive`): Switch the Python find-bar search on or off; off is TouchDesigner's own find bar. Method `ToggleActive`.
- **Toggle fuzzy find** (id `togglefuzzy`): Also match loosely in the find bar: first letters of words, a typo or two. Method `ToggleFuzzy`.
- **Toggle legacy find** (id `togglelegacy`): Search like TouchDesigner's own find bar: names that start with the text, case-sensitive. Method `ToggleLegacy`.

## Hotkeys

- `ctrl.f` (`Findbarshortcut` on `FNS_SearchFix`)

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_PaneSearchRegistry`

## Parameters

### SearchFix

- **Active** (`par.Active`, Toggle), default `on`: Patch every network editor find bar with the Python search. Off: every find bar is exactly as TouchDesigner made it.
- **Legacy Search** (`par.Legacy`, Toggle), default `off`: TouchDesigner's own search: names that start with the text, case-sensitive, in the current network only. Also a toggle in each find bar.
- **Fuzzy** (`par.Fuzzy`, Toggle), default `off`: Also match loosely: the first letters of words (sschg), one or two typos (nosie), or the letters in order. Ranked below every exact, prefix, word and substring hit. Also a toggle in each find bar.
- **Deep Depth** (`par.Depth`, Int), default `3`: Where a find bar's depth field starts when its Deep toggle is first switched on. Counted like findChildren's limit: 1 is the current network only, 2 adds the networks inside it, and so on. Each pane's bar keeps its own.
- **Max Results** (`par.Maxresults`, Int), default `500`: The most results kept per search, best first. The search runs on every keystroke, so this bounds its cost on large networks.
- **Shortcut Closes Find Bar** (`par.Togglefindbar`, Toggle), default `on`: TouchDesigner's find bar shortcut does nothing while you type in the bar. On: the shortcut closes the bar from there too, with the bar's own close button. Off: TouchDesigner's behaviour.
- **Find Bar Shortcut** (`par.Findbarshortcut`, Str): TouchDesigner's own find bar shortcut, which this listens for to close an open bar. It cannot move TouchDesigner's shortcut, so change it only if TouchDesigner's has changed.
- **Repatch Find Bars** (`par.Repatch`, Pulse): Apply the patch to every find bar again, for example after TouchDesigner rebuilt its UI.

# SearchPalette

Package `FNS_SearchPalette`.

Search field for TouchDesigner's palette browser, installed into the palette on startup. Based on Yea Chen's TD-SearchPalette.

- Category: Interface
- Version: 3.2.11
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-searchpalette/

## What it does

- **Find components in the palette browser**: A search field in TouchDesigner's palette browser lists the matching components from every folder; it is put in every time a project opens, or added and removed on demand.
- **Focus the field by hotkey**: `Ctrl+Shift+F` brings TouchDesigner's own palette tab to the front and puts the cursor in an empty search field; the key is rebindable in HotkeyManager.
- **Ranked substring search**: Finds a word anywhere in a name, combines several words, and lists exact, prefix and word-start matches first.
- **Wildcard patterns**: Words with `*` or `?` match as patterns from the front of a name, so a wildcard can only widen the search.
- **Exclude matches with a minus**: A word starting with `-` takes its matches out of the results.
- **Fuzzy fallback for typos and spellings**: When nothing matches as typed, it tries the other side's spelling, initials, a typo, and finally letters in order.
- **Folder search**: A word containing / matches the palette folder, so tools/ on its own lists a whole folder.
- **Latest version only**: Numbered or duplicate copies of one component collapse to the most recently modified file.
- **Jump by word in the field**: The field edits like TouchDesigner's own text fields, including `Ctrl+Left` and `Ctrl+Right` to jump by word.

## Reach it

`op.TDX_SEARCH_PALETTE` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

No promoted API: the package has no extension. Its parameters, listed below, are its surface.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

- `ctrl.shift.f` (`Shortcuts` on `FNS_SearchPalette`)

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`

## Parameters

### TD-SearchPalette

- **Auto Install at startup** (`par.Autoinstall`, Toggle), default `on`: Put the search field into TouchDesigner's palette browser every time the project opens. This choice roams with your config, so it holds across projects.
- **Install** (`par.Install`, Pulse): Add the search field to the palette browser now, without waiting for the next project start.
- **Uninstall** (`par.Uninstall`, Pulse): Take the search field back out of the palette browser and leave TD's own UI as it was.
- **Live Search** (`par.Livesearch`, Toggle), default `on`: Rebuild the result list on every keystroke. Off waits until you stop typing, and is worth turning off only if a very large palette makes typing feel heavy.
- **Folder Search (token/)** (`par.Foldersearch`, Toggle), default `on`: Let a token containing '/' match the FOLDER instead of the component name, so 'gen/ noise' means folder ~gen and name ~noise, and 'tools/' on its own lists a folder.
- **Latest Version Only** (`par.Latestonly`, Toggle), default `on`: Collapse numbered versions of one component (tool, tool1, tool2, or the same name in two folders) to the most recently modified file.
- **Search Hotkey** (`par.Shortcuts`, Str): Keyboard shortcut that opens the Palette Browser and focuses this search field. Rebindable here or in FNS_HotkeyManager; combos join with '.' and several are separated by spaces.
- **Hide Palette When Idle** (`par.Autohide`, Toggle), default `off`: Close the palette browser after it has gone unused for the number of minutes below. Unused means the mouse is outside the palette and nothing is being typed into the search field. Off by default; the palette stays open until you close it.
- **Hide After (Minutes)** (`par.Autohideminutes`, Float), default `5.0`: Minutes without interaction before the palette browser closes, when Hide Palette When Idle is on. The countdown restarts whenever the mouse enters the palette or the search field is typed into.

### Help

- **Github Page** (`par.Githubpage`, Pulse): Open the upstream project's GitHub page (Yea Chen's TD-SearchPalette) in your browser.
- **Release Notes** (`par.Releasenotes`, Pulse): Open the upstream project's release notes in your browser.
- **Version** (`par.Version`, Str): The vendored component's own version, as its author numbers it. Not the package version the updater compares.
- **TD Build** (`par.Tdbuild`, Str): The TouchDesigner build this component was authored against.
- **Author** (`par.Author`, Str), default `Yea Chen <yeataro@gmail.com>`: Who wrote the component this package vendors.

# SetSmoothness

Package `FNS_SetSmoothness`.

Set Input/Viewer Smoothness on selected TOPs, or on every TOP in the network.

- Category: Parameters
- Version: 3.2.10
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-setsmoothness/

## What it does

- **Set smoothness on selected TOPs**: Click the toolbar button, pick a filtering mode, and it is written to the Input and Viewer Smoothness of the selected TOPs.
- **Apply to every TOP in the network**: Hold `Alt` while picking to write it to every TOP in the current network.
- **Change input and viewer smoothness separately**: Set the two values separately on the component and apply them with a pulse or a quick-launch command.
- **Components with their own smoothness**: Components that carry their own Input or Viewer Smoothness parameters, such as RealRamp, are set along with the TOPs.
- **Run from quick-launch**: Smoothness -> selected and Smoothness -> all apply the settings with no toolbar button needed.

## Reach it

`op.SMOOTHNESS_SET` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `OnAll()`: Set the configured smoothness on every operator in the current network.
- `OnSelected()`: Set the configured smoothness on the selected operators; called by the hotkey.
- `SmoothnessAll()`: Apply the smoothness setting to all operators in the network.
- `SmoothnessSelected()`: Apply the smoothness setting to the selected operators.

## Commands

- **Smoothness -> all** (id `smoothnessall`): Apply the smoothness setting to all operators in the network. Method `SmoothnessAll`.
- **Smoothness -> selected** (id `smoothnessselected`): Apply the smoothness setting to the selected operators. Method `SmoothnessSelected`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_ToolbarRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Input Smoothness** (`par.Inputfiltertype`, Menu), default `linear`, menu `nearest`, `linear`, `mipmap`: The Input Smoothness value written to the TOPs you apply to: how the texture is sampled coming in. 'Use Input' leaves each TOP's existing setting alone.
- **Viewer Smoothness** (`par.Filtertype`, Menu), default `linear`, menu `useinput`, `nearest`, `linear`: The Viewer Smoothness value written to the TOPs you apply to: how the texture is filtered when displayed. 'Use Input' leaves each TOP's existing setting alone.
- **Selected** (`par.Selected`, Pulse): Apply the two smoothness settings above to the currently selected TOPs.
- **All** (`par.All`, Pulse): Apply the two smoothness settings above to every TOP in the current network.
- **Modifier Key** (`par.Keys`, Str): Modifier held while scrolling to set input smoothness on the hovered operator.

# SwapOps

Package `FNS_SwapOps`.

Swap one operator for another while keeping connections intact.

- Category: Network
- Version: 3.2.10
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-swapops/

## What it does

- **Swap two operators**: Two selected operators trade places and connections, from the hotkey, the toolbar button or quick-launch.
- **Wires stay on their inputs**: Connections keep their input and output numbers, so a Merge or Composite keeps its input order, and COMPs keep their top and bottom connections.
- **Mirror a row**: With more than two operators selected, the row is mirrored end to end.
- **Keep extra inputs in place**: When one operator takes fewer inputs than the other, the inputs it cannot hold stay where they were.
- **Undo the whole swap in one step**: A single undo puts everything back.

## Reach it

`op.SWAP_OPS` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `OnSwap()`: Swap the positions and the wiring of the selected operators, pairwise from the outside in; called by the hotkey.
- `SwapSelected()`: Swap the connections of the selected operators.

## Commands

- **Swap selected ops** (id `swapselected`): Swap the connections of the selected operators. Method `SwapSelected`.

## Hotkeys

- `alt.shift.s` (`Shortcuts` on `FNS_SwapOps`)

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

- `FNS_ConfigRegistry`
- `FNS_ToolbarRegistry`

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Active** (`par.Active`, Toggle), default `on`: Turn SwapOps on or off. When on, the shortcut and the toolbar button swap the selected operators in place. Off leaves the component installed but idle.
- **Swap** (`par.Swap`, Pulse): Swap the operators selected right now, the same action as the shortcut and the toolbar button.
- **Shortcuts** (`par.Shortcuts`, Str), default `alt.shift.s`: Key that swaps the selected operators. Two swap with each other; a longer selection is mirrored end to end.

# SwitchTools

Package `FNS_SwitchTools`.

A companion for any Switch, Cross or multi-input operator: index by slider, menu or bind, loop or clamp, colour the live input, cook only the inputs in use and unload the rest from the GPU, plus reorder, reverse, randomize and align the inputs.

- Category: Show & output
- Version: 1.1.9
- Access: Base
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-switchtools/

## What it does

- **Drive the switch index**: Binds the switch's index to its own Index, so a slider, a menu of input names, a CHOP or a bound parameter drives it.
- **Loop, clamp or zigzag**: Decides what happens when the index runs past the last input: clamp at the ends, loop round to the first, or zigzag back.
- **Crossfade between inputs**: With Blend on, index values between two inputs crossfade between them.
- **Colour the live input**: Colours the input on screen in the network editor and the rest in a second colour.
- **Cook only what is on screen**: Input components the switch is not showing stop cooking until they are selected again.
- **Release unused memory**: Frees the CPU and GPU memory of inputs that went off screen, spread over several frames so the switch does not hitch.
- **Reverse or shuffle the inputs**: Flips or shuffles the input order in one click, and Restore Original goes back to the saved wiring.
- **Reorder inputs to match the layout**: Rewires the switch so the top node is the first input, or moves the nodes to match the wiring.
- **Align and rename input nodes**: Lines the input nodes up beside the switch and renames them so their digits match their index.
- **Callbacks on cook and selection changes**: Run your own Python when inputs start or stop cooking, or are selected and unselected.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. Place a copy: it is the FNS operator family member `switchTools` (Switch Tools) on the FNS tab of the OP Create dialog, also at `<user palette>/FNSTools/FNS/FNS_SwitchTools.tox`. Its promoted methods are called on the placed copy.

## Promoted API

- `NumInputs` (attribute)
- `SwitchOP` (attribute)

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Switch OP** (`par.Switchop`, OP): The Switch, Cross or multi-input operator to drive. Dropping the tool next to it or docking it sets this too.
- **Bind** (`par.Bind`, Toggle), default `off`: Bind the switch operator's index (or Cross) to this tool's Index, so either one moves the other.
- **Control** (`par.Control`, Header)
- **Index** (`par.Index`, Float), default `0.0`: Which input is shown. With Blend on, values between inputs crossfade.
- **Blend** (`par.Blend`, Toggle), default `off`: Turn on the switch operator's blending between inputs, so fractional indexes crossfade.
- **Loop Type** (`par.Type`, Menu), default `off`, menu `off`, `clamp`, `loop`, `zigzag`: What happens when Index runs past the first or last input: off, clamp at the ends, loop round, or zigzag back.
- **Select** (`par.Select`, Menu): Pick an input by name; sets Index.
- **Current Select** (`par.Currentselect`, Menu): Read-only: the input currently shown.
- **Out Index** (`par.Outindex`, Float), default `0.0`: Read-only: the index actually sent to the switch operator after Loop Type.
- **Num Inputs** (`par.Numinputs`, Int), default `0`: Read-only: how many inputs the switch operator has.
- **Cooker** (`par.Cooker`, Header)
- **Control Cook (COMPs)** (`par.Controlcook`, Toggle), default `off`: Let only the input COMPs in use cook; the rest stop cooking until selected.
- **Unload GPU** (`par.Unloadgpu`, Toggle), default `off`: When an input stops being used, release its COMP's CPU/GPU memory a few frames later (cancelled if it is selected again first), paced by Unload Method and Unload Budget.
- **Unload Method** (`par.Unloadmethod`, Menu), default `progressive`, menu `progressive`, `legacy`: How an unused input COMP's memory is released. Progressive uses COMP.progressiveUnload() paced by Unload Budget and covers every node type including POPs. Immediate calls unload() on each unlocked TOP in one frame (the previous behaviour).
- **Unload Budget (ms/frame)** (`par.Unloadbudget`, Float), default `2.0`: Milliseconds per frame spent releasing an unused input's memory (COMP.progressiveUnload). Spreads the unload over several frames so a heavy input never hitches the frame it stops being used. 0 unloads everything in a single frame.
- **Colorize** (`par.Colorize`, Toggle), default `off`: Colour input nodes by state: On Color for the one in use, Off Color for the rest.
- **On Color** (`par.Oncolor`, RGBA x3), default `0.0`: Node colour of the input in use, with Colorize on.
- **Off Color** (`par.Offcolor`, RGBA x3), default `1.0`: Node colour of the inputs not in use, with Colorize on.
- **Active** (`par.Active`, Toggle), default `on`: Turn the tool off without removing it: the switch operator is unbound and left as it is.

### Inputs

- **Reverse Inputs** (`par.Reverseinputs`, Pulse): Reverse the order the inputs are wired in.
- **Randomize Inputs** (`par.Randomize`, Pulse): Rewire the inputs in a random order.

# TimelineRegistry

Package `FNS_TimelineRegistry`.

Publish a widget into TouchDesigner's timeline bar: transport controls beside the stock ones, an entry on the time-properties block, or a full-width strip in the frame-ruler band that gets its own row.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.8
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-timelineregistry/

## What it does

- **Stock bar when unused**: With nothing contributed the timeline bar stays stock, and it returns to its stock height when the last widget goes.
- **Background zone adds a row**: The background zone makes the bar taller by its own height, recomputed from the stock height each time so the bar never creeps taller.
- **Publish widgets to the timeline bar**: A tool publishes a panel COMP and it appears in the timeline bar, shown through mirrors so the stock blocks stay as they are.
- **Transport, ruler and graph-heading zones**: A widget sits at the right end of the transport row, as a full-width strip under the frame-ruler numbers, or in the Animation editor's graph heading.
- **Register through a host copy**: A tool ships a small host copy whose Registration page names the COMP, canonical name, zone, order and whether it is displayed.
- **Python registration API**: RegisterWidget, UnregisterWidget and SetWidgetZone on op.FNS_TIMELINEREGISTRY add, remove and move widgets from Python; the zone settles a frame later.

## Reach it

A registry. `op.FNS_TIMELINEREGISTRY` is its global shortcut, promoted into /sys/FNS_Registries while the toolkit runs: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project, never on the master inside the toolkit root. See registries.md.

## Promoted API

- `AcceptsDrop(items)`: True when at least one dropped item could become a host here.
- `AdoptTimelineWidget(widget_op, canonical_name, order=None, display=True)`: Take a panel that is ALREADY in the timeline under registry management (TD's built-in transport controls), so it can be reordered, grouped and hidden like any published widget.
- `CreateGroup(first, last=None, label=None)`: Manager API: wrap the run from `first` to `last` (inclusive, in current bar order) in a new group.
- `EnsureSection(host, name, height=18, spec=None)`: Create or update a managed section container inside `host`.
- `GroupPath(canonical_name)`: Manager API: 'outer / inner' label path for an entry, '' if loose.
- `GroupVisibility` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `GroupVisible(group_id)`: Manager API: is this group expanded (default yes).
- `Groups` (property): Manager API: {group_id: {'label', 'members', 'parent', 'visible'}}.
- `HostCanonical` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `OpenConfigurator()`: No dedicated configurator yet -- the timeline surface is managed through the registry API (and, once it ships a hub tab, through FNS_Hub).
- `PackageDrop(comp)`: Turn a dropped panel COMP into a self-registering host of this surface.
- `PaneRegistry` (stored item: a value the extension keeps on the COMP, read as an attribute)
- `PlaceWidgetSequence(canonical_names)`: Manager API for the AUTOMATIC passes (FNS_Hub's boot adoption, its stored-order apply and the group-bracket restore): arrange the bar in the given order without moving a published tool or writing to any host.
- `RegisterDivider(canonical_name, order=None, width=None, display=True, zone=None)`: Publish a VIRTUAL divider -- a registry-owned blank separator with no backing widget.
- `RegisterWidget(widget_op, canonical_name, order=None, display=True, callback=None, source_registry=None, width=None, height=None, help_url=None, zone=None)`: Publish a panel COMP into the timeline under canonical_name.
- `RemoveDivider(canonical_name)`: Remove a registered divider by name; False when the name is not a divider.
- `RemoveGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: dissolve a group -- both markers go, members stay exactly where they are and keep their own display flags, so anything the group was hiding comes back.
- `RenameGroup(group_id, label)`: Manager API: relabel a group (id and markers untouched).
- `SetGroupVisible(group_id, visible)`: Manager API: expand/collapse a group WITHOUT touching any member's own display flag, so expanding restores exactly what was showing.
- `SetWidgetDisplay(canonical_name, visible)`: Manager API: show or hide a registered widget.
- `SetWidgetOrder(canonical_name, order)`: Manager API: reposition a registered widget.
- `SetWidgetSequence(canonical_names)`: Manager API for the USER's edit (the Hub's drag, group, divider and restore actions): reassign order 1..N from the given full sequence and write each number back to its host, which is the user's layout from then on (FNS_ConfigRegistry roams
- `SetWidgetWidth(canonical_name, width)`: Manager API: override an entry's width (applied to the MIRROR, matchsize off -- the source widget's own size is never touched).
- `SetWidgetZone(canonical_name, zone)`: Manager API: move a registered entry to another timeline zone.
- `StampHost(target_comp, canonical_name=None, autoregister=True, promote_pars=True, par_values=None)`: Copy THIS master into `target_comp` as a configured host.
- `ToggleGroup(group_id)`: Manager API: flip a group; returns the new state.
- `UnregisterPanel(canonical_name)`: RegistryBase's teardown name for UnregisterWidget.
- `UnregisterWidget(canonical_name)`: Remove a timeline entry; an adopted native control gets its visibility back (forwarded to the /sys global).
- `WidgetSequence` (property): Manager API: canonical names in current order.
- `WidgetTarget(canonical)`: Resolve the live widget COMP for a registered canonical name.
- `Widgets` (property): Manager API: snapshot of all registered entries.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Registration

- **Widget COMP** (`par.Comp`, COMP), default `..`: Panel COMP published as the toolbar widget. Defaults to the parent component.
- **Canonical Name** (`par.Canonicalname`, Str): Unique name for this widget in the global toolbar registry.
- **Callback DAT** (`par.Callback`, DAT): Optional DAT with toolbar callbacks for this widget.
- **Auto-register** (`par.Autoregister`, Toggle), default `off`: When on, keep this widget published into the global toolbar registry while this component exists.
- **Register** (`par.Register`, Pulse): Publish once into the global toolbar registry, even if Auto-register is off.
- **Unregister** (`par.Unregister`, Pulse): Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.
- **Registration Status** (`par.Regstatus`, Str): Read-only status of this host registration.
- **Timeline Order** (`par.Menuorder`, Int), default `-1`: Preferred order among registered widgets, managed by the global registry. -1 = no preference (append at the end).
- **Displayed** (`par.Displayed`, Toggle), default `on`: Default visibility of the widget in the toolbar (managed by the global registry).
- **Bar Width** (`par.Barwidth`, Int), default `0`: Width of this widget in the toolbar. 0 = auto (follow the widget). Persisted here; the registry writes manager edits back.
- **Bar Height** (`par.Barheight`, Int), default `0`: Height of this widget in its zone. 0 = the zone's own row height. The registry sizes the SOURCE panel to this, because a mirror is a window onto the widget and not a scaler, so an oversized source shows only its top-left corner in the slot.
- **Timeline Zone** (`par.Zone`, Menu), default `transport`, menu `transport`, `background`, `graphheading`: Which part of TD's timeline this widget is published into. 'Transport row' appends it after the native play/stop controls. 'Properties block' places it in the left 279px column. 'Background strip' spans the full width in the frame-ruler band and is drawn UNDERNEATH the ruler. The ruler's own background is transparent, so it shows through.
- **Help URL** (`par.Helpurl`, Str): The tool's wiki/help page opened from the Configurator (right-click the Name cell). Leave empty to auto-discover from a docsHelper COMP (its Url par) inside the registered panel or its parent.
- **Promote Parameters** (`par.Promotepars`, Toggle), default `on`: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.
- **Pre-Save Heal** (`par.Presaveheal`, Toggle), default `on`: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

# ToolbarRegistry

Package `FNS_ToolbarRegistry`.

The toolbar surface registry and mirror rail. The raw master, promoted to /sys; clone it to put your own tools on the bar.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.9
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-toolbarregistry/

## What it does

- **Bookmark bar slots, order and visibility**: Keeps which widgets sit on TouchDesigner's bookmark bar, in what order and which are shown, so installing or removing a tool never leaves a hole or a dead button.

- **Layout follows you**: Your arrangement is saved with your settings and comes with you to every project.
- **Reset the toolbar layout**: Reset toolbar puts every tool back in the slot it shipped in.
- **Drop a panel on the FNS button**: Dropping any panel COMP on the FNS button gives it a self-registering host and puts it on the bar, the quickest way to add a tool of your own.

# Updater

Package `FNS_Updater`.

In-place toolkit updates, with settings preserved across the replacement.

- Category: Core
- Version: 3.2.31
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-updater/

## What it does

- **Check for updates**: Compares every installed package with the published release, from the Updates tab or quick-launch, downloading only a small manifest.
- **Update only changed packages**: Fetches only the packages that changed from the store, verifies each download's hash and replaces just those, leaving uninstalled packages uninstalled.
- **Settings kept across updates**: Saves every tool's settings before anything is replaced, and each replaced tool comes back with them.
- **Store for offline installs**: Keeps the whole release in this machine's store, so Pick Tools works without an internet connection.
- **Patreon sign-in and licence keys**: Holds this machine's Patreon sign-in and Gumroad licence keys; the token lives in the operating system keystore, never in the project.
- **Release notes after an update**: A pass that updated something prints the release and its notes in the Textport; the Updates tab keeps them, and one switch turns the line off.
- **Install agent skill**: The Install agent skill command copies a reference to every installed package (promoted methods, commands, hotkeys, parameters, the registries) into the project's .claude/skills folder or your user skills folder, so a coding agent such as Claude Code knows the toolkit before it touches the project.

## Reach it

`op.FNS_UPDATER` is its global shortcut: call its promoted methods on that object from anywhere in the project.

## Promoted API

- `Account()`: The stored account record, or None.
- `AgentSkillFolder()`: Where the agent skill lives on this machine: <user palette>/FNSTools/agent-skill, or '' when this install has no user palette folder.
- `AuthStatus()`: A one-line account status for the UI: signed out, or the tier label and the package count.
- `BaseUrl()`: The manifest base this pass should use.
- `BestVariant(name, manifest=None)`: The highest build of `name` this account holds: 'base', or a variant id whose product (FNS_Foo.pro) the account is entitled to, ranked by its tier's place in the ladder.
- `CachedToken()`: A still-valid download token, or ''.
- `CancelPending()`: Stop waiting on a sign-in or a membership check (the picker's Cancel).
- `Check(_=None)`: Pulse handler for the Check parameter: CheckUpdates() while Active.
- `CheckForUpdates()`: Check the store for FunctionStore tool updates.
- `CheckUpdates(target=None)`: Fetch the manifest, then compare.
- `CommunityList()`: The curated list, from its cached copy.
- `Compare(target=None)`: What this project has vs what the store publishes.
- `DiscoveredBase()`: Where discovery says the manifest lives, or '' if it has never successfully been read on this machine.
- `Drain()`: Public entry so a stalled pass can be nudged from the textport.
- `DropCachedToken()`: Forget the cached download token.
- `Entitlements()`: Package names this install may download.
- `FamilyFolder()`: Where the FNS family's operators live: <user palette>/FNSTools/FNS, or '' when this install has no user palette folder.
- `FindStandalone(target=None, _index=None)`: Standalone copies of global tools anywhere in this project.
- `GateUrl()`: The entitlement gate's base URL (the Gateurl parameter, the production gate by default).
- `InstallAgentSkill(where: Literal['project', 'user'] = 'project', agents_md: bool = False)`: Copy the FNSTools agent skill into this project or your user skills folder.
- `InstallCommunityPackage(name, target=None)`: Install a tdp highlight into the project's venv and place its tox in `target`.
- `Installed(target=None)`: package -> {sha256, release, when} as recorded at install time.
- `IsApplying()`: Is a pass replacing packages right now?
- `IsEntitled(package)`: Whether the stored account holds a package.
- `IsSignedIn()`: Whether an account record is stored on this install.
- `IsUpdatable` (attribute)
- `KeepStore()`: Mirror the rest of the release into the store, when Keepstore says so and no job is running: what RefreshStore returns, or why not.
- `MissingFor(package)`: What to TELL someone who cannot have this package -- naming the ROUTES, not just the refusal: the tier it unlocks at (or higher; the ladder grants upward) and, where a Gumroad row exists, the lifetime key.
- `Notices()`: Messages the discovery document wants every install to see.
- `OnAuthCallback(token, cn='', code='')`: The gate redirected back to loopback.
- `OnClaimResponse(statusCode, data)`: Web Client DAT callback for /session/claim.
- `OnDownloadAborted(callbackInfo)`: Downloader callback for a failed fetch: try the next discovery pin, classify a missing signature, or record the artifact failure.
- `OnFileDownloaded(callbackInfo)`: Dispatch by filename -- the downloader is shared, so the arriving file says what it was for.
- `OnRecheckResponse(statusCode, data)`: Web Client DAT callback for /session/recheck.
- `OnRedeemResponse(statusCode, data)`: Web Client DAT callback for the licence redeem request: store the products a key unlocks, or report the refusal.
- `OnRevokeResponse(statusCode, data)`: Web Client DAT callback for /session/revoke.
- `OnTokenResponse(statusCode, data)`: Web Client DAT callback for /token/download.
- `PlaceCommunityTool(name, target=None)`: Download one community tool and place it in the project.
- `Plusactive` (property): True when this install holds at least one entitled package.
- `PythonEnvStatus()`: Whether the project can take a tdp install: `ready` with the env, or where TD's environment manager stands (`none`, `creating`, `error`).
- `RebuildPaletteIndex()`: Regenerate <userPalette>/paletteData.json from a directory walk and ask TD to re-read it.
- `Recheck(callback=None)`: Ask the gate to re-read entitlement from Patreon RIGHT NOW.
- `RecordInstalled(name, sha256, release='', target=None)`: Upsert one package's install-time hash.
- `RedeemKey(key=None, product=None, package=None)`: Redeem one Gumroad licence key.
- `Redeemlicense(par)`: Pulse handler for the Redeemlicense parameter: RedeemKey().
- `RefreshCommunity()`: Fetch the curated list.
- `RefreshStore(names=None)`: Fetch the manifest, then artifacts whose bytes differ.
- `Refreshstore(_=None)`: Pulse handler for the Refreshstore parameter: RefreshStore().
- `RequestToken(callback=None)`: Ask the gate for a download token.
- `SetUpPythonEnv()`: Give the project a Python environment with TouchDesigner's own TDPyEnvManager: drop it at `/` and switch it Active, which shows Derivative's disclaimer (their consent step, never bypassed), then press its Create vEnv.
- `SignIn()`: Open the browser and listen on loopback for the gate to hand back a device token.
- `SignOut()`: Revoke the device session at the gate, best effort, and forget the account locally.
- `Signin(par)`: Pulse handler for the Signin parameter: SignIn().
- `Signout(par)`: Pulse handler for the Signout parameter: SignOut().
- `StoreFolder()`: Machine-wide package store.
- `StoreManifest()`: What the store holds, as of its last refresh.
- `StoreStatus()`: What the store actually holds, verified against its manifest.
- `SyncAgentSkillFolder()`: Lay the agent skill bundle out in the agent skill folder from the transport document (the store's copy, or this source checkout's own build): every file written where its text differs, anything else under the bundle folder removed.
- `SyncFamilyFolder()`: Mirror every family member the store holds into the family folder (tox plus sidecar, public names), drop what no longer belongs, let TDFam re-read the folder and TD's Palette re-read its index.
- `TakeOver(path, confirm=False, target=None)`: Bring one standalone copy of a global tool under the toolkit.
- `Update(_=None)`: Pulse handler for the Update parameter: UpdateProject() while Active.
- `UpdateProject(names=None, target=None)`: Fetch the manifest, pull only the artifacts THIS project needs, then replace those packages.
- `UpdateTools()`: Download and install available tool updates.

## Commands

- **Check for updates** (id `checkforupdates`): Check the store for FunctionStore tool updates. Method `CheckForUpdates`.
- **Install agent skill** (id `installagentskill`): Copy the FNSTools agent skill into this project or your user skills folder Method `InstallAgentSkill`. Params: `where: menu = 'project'`, `agents_md: toggle = False`.
- **Update tools** (id `updatetools`): Download and install available tool updates. Method `UpdateTools`.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Base URL** (`par.Baseurl`, Str): Where the published manifest lives. Fetches <Base URL>/manifest.json; artifact URLs come from that manifest, pinned to their release. A local folder or file:// path works too, which is how the flow is exercised without a bucket.
- **Enabled** (`par.Active`, Toggle), default `off`: Master switch for the Check and Update pulses.
- **Use Discovery** (`par.Usediscovery`, Toggle), default `on`: Resolve the manifest location from the pinned discovery document instead of trusting Base URL. Leave on: it is what lets the bucket move without a component update, and it carries the minimum-version and notice channel. Turning it off pins this install to Base URL forever. A local or file:// Base URL always wins regardless.
- **Store Folder** (`par.Storefolder`, Folder): Machine-wide package store the manifest and artifacts are fetched into. Blank means <user palette>/FNSTools/store.
- **Target** (`par.Target`, COMP), default `parent()`: The toolkit container whose packages are compared and updated.
- **Show Download Progress** (`par.Showprogress`, Toggle), default `off`: Open the downloader's progress window while files are fetched.
- **Show Notes After Update** (`par.Shownotes`, Toggle), default `on`: After an update pass finishes, the Textport gets one line naming the release and its notes. Turn this off to skip it; the notes stay readable on the Hub's Updates tab either way. This is never a popup and never fires on project start. Roams with your settings.
- **Keep the Whole Release in the Store** (`par.Keepstore`, Toggle), default `on`: After an install or an update pass, also download the rest of the release into this machine's store (about 12 MB), so Pick Tools works offline and everything the store can offer is already here. Off: only what you install is fetched.
- **Refresh Store** (`par.Refreshstore`, Pulse): Fetch the manifest and every artifact whose bytes differ into the store. Machine-wide: no project is touched.
- **Check for Updates** (`par.Check`, Pulse): Fetch the manifest and compare it against this project's install record. Cheap: no artifacts are downloaded.
- **Status** (`par.Status`, Str): Result of the last check, refresh or update pass.
- **Update This Project** (`par.Update`, Pulse): Fetch the artifacts this project needs and replace only the packages whose bytes differ. Never installs a package you did not choose.
- **Gate URL** (`par.Gateurl`, Str): Where entitlement is checked and gated packages are fetched from. Placeholder until the gate is deployed; it is the only address this component knows for paid downloads.

# VSCodeTools

Package `FNS_VSCodeTools`.

VS Code integration: open externalized scripts, sync files and generate TouchDesigner type stubs.

- Category: Developer
- Version: 3.2.10
- Access: Free
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/fns-vscodetools/

## What it does

- **Open the project in VS Code**: One click creates the project's workspace file and opens it in VS Code or Cursor.
- **Sync a DAT to a file**: `Ctrl+Shift+E` writes the DAT you are on to a file named after it, and from then on the DAT and the file stay in sync both ways.

None.

# FeedbackDisplace

A feedback loop with a displace stage inside it: opacity, crossfade, filter size, displacement driven by a built-in noise or a second input, a per-pass transform, reset and a dry/wet mix. An alternative for the Feedback TOP.

- Category: Visual
- Version: 1.0.7
- Access: Base
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/feedbackdisplace/

## What it does

- **Trails with opacity and blur**: Each pass is composited over the input with an opacity and a blur, so trails, smears and echoes come straight from the parameters.
- **Noise or image displacement**: Warps every pass by a built-in animated noise, or by a displacement map wired into the in_displace input.
- **Zoom, spin and drift each pass**: Applies a transform on every pass for drift, zoom and spin, including infinite zooms.
- **Reset the loop**: Hold Reset to clear the loop, including the faint ghost an 8-bit loop at a high opacity leaves behind.
- **Mix dry and wet**: Dry / Wet Mix blends the whole effect with the input, and Cross fades between the fresh input and the loop.
- **Replace a Feedback TOP**: Offered in place of a Feedback TOP created with the alternatives shortcut held, wired into the same spot; also on the OP Create dialog's FNS tab.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. Place a copy: it is the FNS operator family member `feedbackDisplace` (Feedback Displace) on the FNS tab of the OP Create dialog, also at `<user palette>/FNSTools/FNS/FeedbackDisplace.tox`. Its promoted methods are called on the placed copy.

## Promoted API

No promoted API: the package has no extension. Its parameters, listed below, are its surface.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

- `feedbackTOP`

## Requires

- `FNS_OpMenuRegistry`

## Parameters

### Feedback

- **Operation** (`par.Operand`, Menu), default `multiply`, menu `add`, `atop`, `average`, `brightest`, `burncolor`, `burnlinear`, `chromadifference`, `color`, `darkercolor`, `difference`, `dimmest`, `divide`, `dodge`, `exclude`, `freeze`, `glow`, `hardlight`, `hardmix`, `heat`, `hue`, `inside`, `insideluminance`, `inverse`, `lightercolor`, `luminancedifference`, `maximum`, `minimum`, `multiply`, `negate`, `outside`, `outsideluminance`, `over`, `overlay`, `pinlight`, `reflect`, `screen`, `softlight`, `linearlight`, `stencilluminance`, `subtract`, `subtractive`, `under`, `vividlight`, `xor`, `yfilm`, `zfilm`: How each pass of the feedback is composited over the input.
- **Opacity** (`par.Opacity`, Float), default `0.9`: How much of the previous frame survives each pass: higher values leave longer trails.
- **Cross** (`par.Cross`, Float), default `0.0`: Crossfades between the fresh input (0) and the feedback loop (1).
- **Filter Size** (`par.Size`, Int), default `1`: Blur on the loop each pass, in pixels.
- **Aspect Correct** (`par.Aspectcorrect`, Toggle), default `on`: Keep the displacement square on non-square images.
- **Displace Weight** (`par.Displaceweight`, XYZW x2), default `0.0`: How far the displacement pushes the image, per axis.
- **Source Midpoint** (`par.Midpoint`, XYZW x2), default `0.5`: The displacement value that means no movement; the default 0.5 centres it.
- **UV Weight** (`par.Uvweight`, Float), default `1.0`: Blend of the displacement into the image coordinates: 0 leaves them untouched.
- **Displace Period** (`par.Period`, Float), default `1.0`: Scale of the built-in noise that drives the displacement: larger periods give broader shapes.
- **Displace Amplitude** (`par.Amp`, Float), default `0.0`: Strength of the built-in noise that drives the displacement.
- **Displace Speed** (`par.Displacespeed`, Float), default `0.0`: How fast the built-in noise moves.
- **T** (`par.T`, XYZW x2), default `0.0`: Translate applied to the loop each pass.
- **Rotate** (`par.Rotate`, XYZW), default `0.0`: Rotation applied to the loop each pass, in degrees.
- **Scale** (`par.S`, XYZW x2), default `1.0`: Scale applied to the loop each pass: a little above 1 zooms the trails outward.
- **Reset** (`par.Reset`, Momentary), default `off`: Clear the feedback loop while held.
- **Dry / Wet Mix** (`par.Drywet`, Float), default `1.0`: Mixes the effect with the input: 0 is the input alone, 1 the full effect.

### About

- **Help** (`par.Help`, Pulse): Open the help for this tool.

# FloatDataRecorder

Records a float texture such as a depth point cloud, a colour texture and a CHOP to files in sync, then plays the three back together against the timeline with a frame offset.

- Category: Show & output
- Version: 1.0.5
- Access: Base

# InstanceTrailer

Turns one moving image into a trail of its recent frames: a cache laid out in a row or column with exponent-shaped spacing, plus the offsets as a CHOP for instancing.

- Category: Visual
- Version: 1.0.4
- Access: Base
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/instancetrailer/

## What it does

- **Trail of recent frames**: Caches incoming frames while an input is wired and lays the latest copies side by side, oldest at one end, newest at the other.
- **Reach and copy count**: Set how many copies the trail holds and how many frames back the oldest one reaches.
- **Shape the time spacing**: An exponent spaces the delays, so the copies bunch up near the present or fan out evenly into the past.
- **Row or column layout**: Lays the copies out left to right, right to left, top to bottom or bottom to top.
- **CHOP output for instancing**: A second output carries the trail as a CHOP in the same layout as the texture, for instanced geometry or CHOP-side use.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. Place a copy: it is the FNS operator family member `instanceTrailer` (Instance Trailer) on the FNS tab of the OP Create dialog, also at `<user palette>/FNSTools/FNS/InstanceTrailer.tox`. Its promoted methods are called on the placed copy.

## Promoted API

No promoted API: the package has no extension. Its parameters, listed below, are its surface.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

## Requires

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Depth** (`par.Depth`, Int), default `10`: Number of delayed copies (instances) drawn in the trail, the live frame included.
- **Max Cache Size** (`par.Maxcachesize`, Int), default `300`: Frames the cache holds. The trail cannot reach further back than this; larger values use more GPU memory.
- **Cache Size** (`par.Cachesize`, Int), default `300`: How many frames back the oldest copy reaches. Clamped to Max Cache Size: the cache holds nothing further back, so a larger value would read empty slots.
- **Direction** (`par.Direction`, Float), default `1.0`: Direction and strength of the time offset, -1 to 1. Positive values delay the copies into the past, negative values reverse the order; at +-1 the oldest copy reaches Cache Size frames back.
- **Exponent Value** (`par.Expval`, Float), default `1.0`: Exponent that spaces the delays: 1 is even spacing, higher values bunch the copies near the live frame. 0 puts every copy on the same frame.
- **Align** (`par.Align`, Menu), default `verttb`, menu `horizlr`, `horizrl`, `verttb`, `vertbt`: How the copies are arranged in the output layout.
- **Recreate All Operators** (`par.Recreateall`, Pulse): Rebuild every replicated copy, for example after changing Depth by a large amount.

# KinectSinglePlayer

Picks one player out of a Kinect skeleton stream: whoever stands inside the bounds you set becomes the active player, and their joints ride out as clean channels until they leave.

- Category: CHOPs & sensing
- Version: 1.0.5
- Access: Base
- Docs: https://functionstore.tools/docs/kinectsingleplayer/

## What it does

- **Select a player by bounds**: Watches a chosen joint of every tracked player and promotes one whose joint sits inside the box you define to active player.
- **Track one player on stable channels**: The active player's joints come out under a stable name, whichever of the six Kinect slots they occupy.
- **Hand over to the next player**: When the active player walks out of the box, the next player in range takes over.
- **Detect whether a player is active**: A separate CHOP output reports whether a player is active right now.
- **Read live or recorded data**: Reads a Kinect CHOP, or any CHOP with Kinect-style channel names such as a recorded take.

## Reach it

No global shortcut. Place a copy: it is the FNS operator family member `kinectSinglePlayer` (Kinect Single Player) on the FNS tab of the OP Create dialog, also at `<user palette>/FNSTools/FNS/KinectSinglePlayer.tox`. Its promoted methods are called on the placed copy.

## Promoted API

No promoted API: the package has no extension. Its parameters, listed below, are its surface.

## Commands

No commands recorded for this package.

## Hotkeys

None.

## Alternative for

None.

Nothing.

## Parameters

### Custom

- **Kinect Data** (`par.Kinectdata`, CHOP): Kinect CHOP (or any CHOP with Kinect-style channels such as p1/spine:tx, p1/id) to pick the single player from. Output channels follow the locked template in null1 (TouchDesigner Kinect v2 names with world, depth-space, bone rotation and length channels); input channels outside that set are not passed through.

TouchDesigner's Kinect CHOP names: hip, spine, neck, head, shoulder_c, shoulder_l/_r, elbow_l/_r, wrist_l/_r, hand_l/_r, hip_l/_r, knee_l/_r, ankle_l/_r, foot_l/_r.
